jobs.title: Human Factors Project Manager (m/f/d) (part-time contractor, 3-month review)
jobs.description:
About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health. 

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US. 

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

About the role
Hilo is looking for an experienced Human Factors Project Manager to own all of our human factors and usability work. Right now that work is split across Product, Design, Clinical Operations, QARA and outside agencies, and no single person is accountable for it. You'll be that person. You'll coordinate the specialists, keep work moving between teams and make sure every deliverable meets the quality and regulatory standard. That frees our domain teams to get back to their own work.

What you'll own

  • Usability studies: You'll own the study calendar, protocols and relationships with external labs such as Sage Research. This covers formative and summative studies across hardware and software, including FDA submission work for Hilo Medical. You'll make sure findings get back to design on a regular schedule.
  • IFU and Quick Start Guide: You'll decide what content goes in the QSG, the app and the IFU. You'll also own version control and localisation (Phrase, Novalins) and brief and manage freelance designers and print partners.
  • Packaging: You'll own packaging briefs from start to finish and coordinate agencies (ARD, Superhuit, Carac Design) and freelance packaging designers. You'll keep the work aligned with regulatory, cost and manufacturing constraints.
  • Clinical studies: You'll connect the human factors evidence from ClinOps-run trials with the human factors evidence for the product we ship to customers.
  • Roadmap and reporting: You'll keep a single human factors roadmap and manage dependencies, resourcing and budgets across teams. Each month you'll report confidence levels and raise any risks to leadership.

This is a part time contractor role of up to three days per week, with a total fee of CHF 17,500 for the initial engagement. We would like to start as soon as possible, with a review after three months.

Requirements

What you'll bring

  • Human factors or usability engineering experience in medical devices, ideally with wearables or connected health
  • Proven project or programme management: you've owned the plan, sequenced multiple workstreams and delivered on deadlines through others
  • Hands-on knowledge of IEC 62366 usability engineering, use-related risk documentation (e.g. UFMEAs) and IFU development
  • Experience managing agencies, labs and freelancers
  • Clear, confident communication, with a track record of connecting Product, Clinical and Quality/Regulatory teams

First priorities

  1. Audit of our current processes and human factors function
  2. Set up the usability study calendar
  3. Get a decision on the content split for the QSG "5-minute sheet" redesign

Nice to have: FDA submission experience, a UX research background, and familiarity with InDesign/Figma localisation workflows

Benefits

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do: 

Move the Needle — You focus on what drives real impact. You let data and clarity guide your decisions, and you take accountability for results. You're a difference maker — you drive ideas to commercial success from start to end. 

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with quality. You treat feedback as a chance to learn, and you're deep in customer and partner feedback — translating it to action quickly. 

Team First — You collaborate effectively across teams and build trust through clarity and respect. You're comfortable bridging local execution with a global team, and you communicate openly across time zones.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Enterprise (B2B)
jobs.description:
About Us

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider helping enterprises and consumer brands deliver seamless connectivity worldwide. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform, proprietary eSIM technology, and its own mobile core network across 15 countries, 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider in 43 countries.


Founded in 2022, 1GLOBAL has rapidly become one of Europe's fastest-growing telecom technology companies, connecting more than 80 million people and devices globally. Our customers include leading banks, multinational enterprises, global retailers, travel companies, payment service providers, and digital-first businesses.


Headquartered in the Netherlands, with R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 550 professionals across 16 countries. With annual revenues exceeding US$200 million and a strong track record of profitability, we continue to invest in innovation, infrastructure, and international expansion as we redefine the future of global mobile connectivity.

About the Team

The Enterprise team owns 1GLOBAL's products for businesses: global mobile connectivity for multinational enterprises, delivered through one platform, one contract and one invoice. Our customers manage their entire mobile estate in the Enterprise Portal, from subscriptions, usage and invoices to orders such as SIM swaps and suspensions, spend alerts, user roles and single sign-on.

We recently retired two legacy portals and moved every enterprise customer onto our new Enterprise Portal. That has created strong demand and a steady flow of requests from customers and internal teams, with a lot of exciting work ahead. We work closely with engineering, design, customer support, customer success, account management, operations and commercial teams.

We are looking for a Product Manager to shape the next chapter of the Enterprise Portal: what we show, how we show it, which reports and analytics we offer, and which actions customers can take themselves. This is a UI and UX-heavy role, where design judgement matters as much as sharp prioritisation.

About the Role

You will lead discovery and delivery for the Enterprise Portal, turning a high volume of customer and internal requests into a clear roadmap and a portal that enterprise customers enjoy using.

  • Own the vision, roadmap and backlog for the Enterprise Portal, deciding which dashboards, reports, analytics and self-service capabilities come next.
  • Run customer and UX research: talk to portal users directly and gather the voice of the customer from support, customer success, account management and operations.
  • Work hands-on with design from first concept to final UI, shaping flows, wireframes and prototypes and holding a high bar for UX and UI quality.
  • Shape the portal's integrations with mobile device management (MDM) platforms such as Jamf and Microsoft Intune, so enterprise IT teams can manage devices and connectivity together.
  • Prioritise work of every size, from small fixes and quick improvements to large multi-quarter projects, and communicate decisions and trade-offs clearly to every stakeholder.
  • Use analytics and data to understand how customers use the portal, spot friction and measure the impact of what we ship.
  • Write clear requirements and acceptance criteria with engineering, understanding the APIs behind the portal well enough to shape what is feasible.

Requirements

About You

Must Have

  • 4+ years in product management, including ownership of a B2B portal, dashboard or web application used by business customers.
  • Hands-on experience with customer and UX research: interviews and turning feedback from many channels into clear problems worth solving.
  • Experience with event-based product analytics such as Amplitude or similar products: defining events, building charts and funnels, and using the data to make decisions.
  • Strong prioritisation across a constant flow of requests, with the judgement to say no and the ability to explain why.
  • Proven collaboration across many departments, from engineering and design to customer success, account management, operations and sales, in fluent written and spoken English.
  • A working understanding of APIs and how a portal reads and writes data through them. This is not a technical role, but API fluency will help you shape what is feasible with engineers.


Nice to Have

  • Telecom experience, for example enterprise mobile services, MVNO platforms or eSIM.
  • Hands-on Amplitude experience, including tracking plans, event taxonomy and dashboards.
  • Experience with design systems, or with data visualisation for business users.

Benefits

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 50% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.


1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

jobs.description:
Are you interested in working with a leading education technology player, the global leader in the assessment and certification of professional skills industry with presence in more than 200 countries worldwide? If so, this is the chance to apply now! 📥

Shape the future of PRINCE2. The home of modern projects, programme, and portfolio management.

PeopleCert is looking for a Product Manager to help take our PRINCE2 portfolio of Best Practice to the next level of success - developing compelling propositions for globally recognised PRINCE2 products that ensure wide adoption among senior audiences, new sectors and markets. You will be responsible for the day-to-day management of key products in the PRINCE2 portfolio – including certifications, official publications and learning materials – making sure they remain high quality, relevant and well supported in market.

As Product Manager for the PRINCE2 portfolio, you will work closely with teams across the business in order to support delivery of the overall roadmap and enable commercial success for your product set within the PRINCE2 portfolio.

As Product Manager PRINCE2 your tasks will be the following:

Product strategy and vision

  • Contribute to the product vision and strategy, and develop and maintain the roadmap for your product set.
  • Conduct market research and analysis to identify trends, customer needs, and competitive landscape that will inform the product strategy.
  • Track agreed product goals and KPIs, and recommend actions to improve performance.

Product management

  • Monitor and analyze product performance, making data-driven recommendations to optimize and enhance your products.
  • Prioritise maintenance and improvement activities for your in-market products, to ensure continued relevance and positive customer experience.

New product development

  • Work proactively and collaboratively with teams across the business to ensure all aspects of product development, launch and in-market support are considered early in the business case and product design phase
  • Support the successful development and launch of new or updated products
  • Participate in all aspects of Product design, including: persona development; full end-to-end user journeys; service blueprints; key content and technical specifications
  • Design and manage the testing strategy for all products in development, to ensure they are consistently meeting the needs of our target audiences

Stakeholder collaboration

  • Contribute key elements to the go-to-market plans developed by Marketing, including positioning, key messaging and more.
  • Contribute to pricing proposals for your product set by providing market, competitor and partner insight, and supporting the relevant internal teams in pricing decisions.
  • Engage with internal and external stakeholders to secure buy-in and understanding of the product vision.

What we look for:

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years’ experience in a Product Manager or Product Owner role in one of the following sectors: education, training, professional qualifications (e.g. ACA / CIPD etc.)
  • Knowledge of PeopleCert best practices and ideally familiar with PRINCE2 or other similar PPM (project, programme and portfolio) certification products.
  • Proven track record of managing multiple products and delivering successful outcomes.
  • Demonstrable experience of managing products through their whole lifecycle
  • Familiarity with all elements of product development, from discovery to delivery
  • Proven ability to evaluate product feedback objectively, and propose solutions to address business needs
  • Strong business/commercial acumen
  • Excellent people and management skills to interact with colleagues, cross-functional teams, and third parties around the world
  • Problem-solving and analytical capabilities.
  • Prior exposure in Education, Consulting, Examination/Certification, or Technology sectors will be considered an asset.
  • Excellent command of the English language (C2 level certification desired; LanguageCert C2 LTE or C2 IESOL a plus).
  • Advanced computer literacy required; ECDL Advanced certification desirable. Familiarity with Microsoft Dynamics CRM or equivalent software will be considered an added advantage.

What we offer:

  • The opportunity to shape globally recognized frameworks used by professionals around the world.
  • A collaborative, high-impact international team and a purpose-driven working culture.
  • Flexible working conditions (location and hours).
  • Two free vouchers for all certifications from PeopleCert's Portfolio per year for all employees
  • Competitive compensation and personal development opportunities.
  • A global network of professionals and subject matter experts.

If you want to become a member of our international, dynamic and agile team that creates world leading software products, then we should certainly like to hear from you!

About PeopleCert

PeopleCert is a global leader in assessment and certification of professional skills, partnering with multi-national organizations and government bodies for the development & delivery of standardized exams. Delivering exams across 200 countries and in 25 languages over its state-of-the-art assessment technology, PeopleCert enables professionals to boost their careers and realize their life ambitions.

Quality, Innovation, Passion, Integrity, Clarity, and Velocity are the core values which guide everything we do.

Our offices in UK, Greece, and Cyprus boast a culture of diversity, where everyone is different, yet everyone fits in. All of us at PeopleCert are committed to the reflection of the diversity and inclusion of our customers and the communities in which we do business.

Working on Home Office (HO) Secure English Language Tests (SELTs)

Any person who is engaged by PeopleCert to work on the SELT service must undergo a Background Check (the results of which must be acceptable to PeopleCert and the HO) prior to commencing their SELT duties. All SELT personnel will be required to complete a declaration (provided by PeopleCert) where the existence of any criminal record and/or bankruptcy must be declared.

If working on the SELT service in the UK, background checks will include:

  • A basic or enhanced Disclosure Barring Service (DBS) check
  • Right to Work in the UK check (including nationality, identity and place of residence)
  • HO security check (Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) or Counter Terrorist Check (CTC)
  • Financial background check
  • Employment reference check.
  • If working on the SELT service anywhere in the world (outside of the UK) personnel will undergo background checks that are equivalent to those stated for the UK.

In addition, if personnel are required to speak to SELT candidates they must be appropriately skilled in English language and, where SELT services are provided anywhere in the world (outside of the UK), the official language of the relevant country.

All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality.

Product Manager - (Contact center as a service)

Localisation : Paris, France (hybride, trois jours par semaine au bureau)
Niveau : confirmé
Équipe : Product Management – Customer Care Value Stream
Contrat : CDI
Rattachement : Head of Product

À noter : Merci de noter : ce poste est basé en France, vous devez y résider ou envisager de vous y installer, et il nécessite un droit de travail existant dans l’UE. Nous ne pouvons pas proposer de sponsoring de visa, mais nous étudions cette possibilité poste par poste, alors n’hésitez pas à consulter régulièrement notre site carrières pour découvrir de futures opportunités.

Le français et l’anglais courants (à l’oral comme à l’écrit) sont indispensables, et nous vous remercions de soumettre votre CV en anglais.

À propos de Kaluza

Kaluza est la plateforme d’intelligence énergétique qui transforme la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les entreprises de l’énergie à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié.

Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel entre les foyers, les appareils, les marchés et les réseaux. En combinant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée au quotidien.

Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des innovateurs comme Volvo et Volkswagen.

Ce que tu feras

Tu es responsable des résultats de ton produit et tu donnes aux équipes design et ingénierie une vision claire des priorités et du périmètre.

  • Travailler avec l’équipe qui construit notre solution de centre de contact et le Kaluza Agent Experience (KAE), au service d’ENGIE France

  • Définir la stratégie produit et la roadmap Customer Care pour les clients de Kaluza en France, en équilibrant réutilisation du Global Core et besoins de localisation

  • Construire notre suite d’outils pour le centre de contact, dont le CCaaS (Contact Centre as a Service) et le Case Management, pour des conversations efficaces et à forte valeur

  • Utiliser les dernières technologies d’IA pour automatiser et personnaliser l’expérience client, et porter les outils de productivité des agents

  • Être l’interlocuteur produit senior de nos clients (comme ENGIE) : animer des ateliers et traduire leurs besoins en capacités scalables

  • Piloter les équipes transverses (ingénierie, design, data, commercial) pour une livraison efficace, en levant les blocages et les dépendances

  • Définir et suivre les indicateurs clés du centre de contact (AHT, FCR, CSAT, NPS) pour obtenir des gains mesurables sur le coût du service

Ce que tu apportes

Idéalement, tu as :

  • Une solide expérience de leadership produit en SaaS entreprise, au sein d’organisations produit agiles

  • Une connaissance approfondie des opérations de centre de contact et des workflows des agents, et de l’enthousiasme pour l’automatisation par l’IA (voicebots, agent assist)

  • Une expérience avec des clients entreprise français et une bonne compréhension des enjeux de localisation (langue, réglementation)

  • De l’aisance avec les parties prenantes au niveau exécutif et la capacité d’arbitrer entre rapidité et valeur à long terme

  • Une approche orientée data : tu t’appuies sur les métriques opérationnelles pour évaluer la performance produit et progresser en continu

  • Un parcours dans la vente d’énergie ou les utilities (un vrai plus !)

Nos valeurs

Cinq valeurs guident notre façon de travailler chez Kaluza :

  • Jouer pour gagner : Une fierté collective à décarboner l’énergie à grande échelle.

  • Résoudre le vrai problème : Aller à l’essentiel dans la complexité pour viser des résultats concrets.

  • Bâtir la confiance chaque jour : Cohérence, transparence et tenir parole.

  • Assumer le résultat : Une responsabilité totale, dans les réussites comme dans les revers, sans ego.

  • Aller plus loin ensemble : Collaboration, respect et diversité des points de vue.

Nos avantages

  • Finance & assurances : Prime discrétionnaire, mutuelle santé Alan, prévoyance décès/invalidité x3 via Alan, et cotisations de Sécurité sociale standard (retraite, allocations familiales, assurance chômage)

  • Indemnités : Remboursement de 50 % des frais de transport, indemnité télétravail de 200 € et budget formation de 150 €

  • Congés & flexibilité : 25 jours de congés + jours fériés + RTT, congé Moments That Matter (Compassionate Leave), deux jours de bénévolat rémunérés, travail flexible et possibilité de congé sabbatique

Viens comme tu es

Nous voulons rencontrer des personnes de tous les horizons. Plus nous sommes inclusifs, meilleur sera notre travail, et nous reconnaissons les talents sur le mérite et le potentiel. Si le poste t’enthousiasme mais que tu ne coches pas toutes les cases, nous serions quand même ravis d’échanger avec toi.

Pour en savoir plus, va voir notre page carrières et notre LinkedIn. Notre politique de protection des données des candidats est disponible ici.

Job title: Product Manager

Location: Paris — Hybrid - 3 days in office

Team: Product Management - Customer Care Value Stream

Reporting to: Head of Product

This role is based in France and requires the successful candidate to be based in or willing to relocate to France.

At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship


Fluent French and English (spoken and written) are essential for this position. Please submit your profile in English.

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today's challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Leveraging Data, AI, and real-time decision-making we turn energy complexity into growth opportunities for our partners.

By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable and affordable.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

Where in the world of Kaluza will I be working

You will be specifically working with the team building out our contact centre solution and the Kaluza Agent Experience (KAE). Our Customer Care platform powers AI-driven, cost-efficient service operations for global energy retailers, enabling personalised customer experiences across contact centres, digital channels, and case management.

This role is mission-critical to Kaluza’s vision. You will lead the product strategy, delivery, and client outcomes for Kaluza’s Customer Care solutions for ENGIE France, while contributing to the evolution of our Global Core capabilities.

What will I be doing?

As the Customer Care Product Manager, you are accountable for the outcomes delivered by your product. You will ensure design and engineering teams have absolute clarity on priorities and scope to drive meaningful results for end users and commercial value.

You will:

  • Lead Product Strategy: Own the Customer Care product strategy and roadmap for Kaluza clients in France, balancing Global Core reuse with specific French localisation requirements.

  • Build High-Value Solutions: Develop our suite of tools for the Contact Centre Solution, including CCaaS (Contact Centre as a Service) and Case Management, to enable efficient, high-value conversations.

  • Drive AI Innovation: Utilise the latest AI technology to automate and personalise the customer experience and champion agent productivity tools.

  • Foster Client Partnerships: Act as the senior product counterpart to client stakeholders (such as ENGIE), leading workshops and translating their needs into scalable capabilities.

  • Execute & Optimise: Lead cross-functional teams (engineering, design, data, and commercial) to ensure efficient delivery, removing blockers and resolving cross-team dependencies.

  • Deliver Operational Excellence: Define and track key contact centre metrics such as AHT, FCR, CSAT, and NPS to ensure solutions deliver measurable cost-to-serve improvements.

Is this the job for me?

You are the right person for us if you:

  • Have significant product leadership experience in enterprise SaaS and have worked in agile product organisations.

  • Possess deep knowledge of contact centre operations and agent workflows.

  • Have experience working with French enterprise clients and a strong understanding of localisation requirements, including language and regulation.

  • Are skilled at stakeholder management at the executive level, with the ability to manage trade-offs between speed and long-term value.

  • Are data-oriented, with an adeptness for using operational metrics to assess product performance and drive continuous improvement.

  • Have a background in energy retail or utilities (this will set you apart!).

  • Are excited by AI-driven automation, including voice bots and agent assist technology.

Kaluza Values

Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business:

Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together

 

We want the best people

We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Core Platform (Engine, Scale & Reliability)
jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

 

Your main goal will be to make n8n's Core Platform ready for the company's next stage of growth: more scalable, reliable, secure, and flexible as customer usage and technical complexity increase. You'll own the foundations that everything else, including our AI and agent capabilities, is built on.

 

To do so, here are your responsibilities:

 

OWN THE CORE PLATFORM STRATEGY & ROADMAP

  • Define and communicate the product strategy and roadmap for the Core Platform in partnership with Engineering and Product leadership.

  • Prioritize foundational investments based on customer impact, enterprise needs, technical risk, and engineering effort, and make trade-offs between near-term customer needs, technical debt, and long-term architecture explicit.

  • Lead product discovery for technically complex problems, engaging directly with enterprise customers and internal customer-facing teams.

 

SCALABILITY, RELIABILITY & EXECUTION ENGINE

  • Drive work on the scalability and reliability of n8n's execution engine, including areas like worker pools and distributed execution.

  • Improve the reliability of triggers and execution behaviour across complex deployment setups, from multi-main Cloud environments to self-hosted enterprise installations.

  • Shape a more secure and flexible approach to executing code within n8n.

 

MAJOR RELEASES & CROSS-ORG ALIGNMENT

  • Drive the planning and release of major or breaking platform versions, including migration strategy, stakeholder communication, and risk management.

  • Establish clear success measures and keep the squad accountable for outcomes, not only delivery.

  • Act as the bridge between the Core team and the wider org: Product, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Support, making platform trade-offs legible without oversimplifying them.

  • Treat internal product teams as customers of the platform: proactively mine their roadmaps for implicit platform requirements and turn cross-cutting needs into explicit Core Platform work before they become blockers.

 

REQUIREMENTS

 

Must-haves

  • Platform product experience: You have 5+ years in Product, with at least 2 to 3 years on platform, infrastructure, developer-facing, or backend/API products.

  • Technical depth: You're credible with senior engineers. You can reason about distributed systems, execution models, and reliability/scalability trade-offs, and hold your own in an architecture discussion. You're at home with non-functional requirements, where the details are the product.

  • Complex delivery track record: You've led cross-team technical initiatives with real delivery risk, ideally including a migration or breaking change.

  • Prioritization under ambiguity: You make trade-offs explicit and connect foundational or technical-debt work to customer and commercial outcomes.

  • Ownership and autonomy: You grab problems without being asked, fix what you see broken, and drive outcomes without waiting for direction.

  • Exceptional communication: You make complex platform topics understandable for technical and non-technical audiences alike.

  • Enterprise platform reality: You understand what running software in customer-controlled environments means, including self-hosted, air-gapped, and restricted deployments

 

Nice-to-haves

  • Hands-on ability: You can read code or prototype, even if you're not shipping it.

  • Enterprise exposure: You've worked with B2B SaaS requirements like security, compliance, or deployment complexity.

  • Security partnership: You're comfortable working with security teams on code execution, isolation, or compliance topics.

  • Domain familiarity: You know workflow automation, orchestration, or open-source / developer-community products.

  • Writing culture: You default to writing things down to create clarity and alignment.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Delivery Manager - Generation Flex
jobs.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Kraken Generation Flex
The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves to be at the heart of that change.

Our aim is to be the leading global provider of solutions that enable customers to release £30bn of value per annum from distributed energy resources (DERs). We are building a Software as a Service (SaaS) subscription business with a global addressable market of £2.4 billion per annum, by digitally connecting hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets.

We have already attained a market leading position and Kraken is a recognised thought leader and innovator in the industry.

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and growth, we're looking for a Generation Flex Delivery Manager to own the successful onboarding of flexible generation and energy assets onto KrakenFlex across the EU with a focus on Germany.

This is a customer-facing delivery role with a strong technical bias. You'll manage an asset through the full onboarding journey, from initial discovery and technical analysis, through site design and gateway installation, to commissioning, testing and handover into live service.

You'll sit at the intersection of our customers, Electrical Engineering, Product and Customer Success Engineering teams. You'll need to understand both the connectivity and control architecture of our customers' assets and how those assets connect to and operate through the KrakenFlex SaaS platform.

You won't be expected to design the details of the integration solution or write the software yourself. Instead, you'll need enough technical depth across both areas to understand how they fit together, identify gaps and risks, challenge incomplete information and drive the right conversations to get a site successfully integrated.

Your role is to bring together three perspectives throughout onboarding:

Customer: What is the customer trying to achieve, and what do we need from them?

Product: How will the asset operate within KrakenFlex, and what product capabilities and configuration are required?

Engineering: How does the physical asset need to be integrated, connected and commissioned to make that solution work?

Your job is to make sure those three come together as one successfully delivered customer solution.

🚀 What you'll own:

  • Own the end-to-end onboarding and delivery of Generation Flex assets BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar), from initial onboarding through analysis, site design, installation, configuration, commissioning, testing and handover into live service.

  • Build a strong understanding of the Generation Flex product and SaaS platform, including how assets are represented, configured, monitored and controlled within KrakenFlex.

  • Understand how the physical site and its electrical/control systems connect into the KrakenFlex software architecture, and bring those two worlds together throughout onboarding.

  • Work closely with Product and Software Engineering teams to understand the relevant GenFlex capabilities, product modules, configuration requirements and technical constraints for each customer and asset.

  • Translate between customer requirements, electrical engineering requirements and SaaS/product requirements, making sure each group understands what is needed from the others.

  • Understand the end-to-end data and control path from the physical asset through site controls, meters, PPCs, gateways and communications infrastructure into Kraken Flex, and from Kraken Flex back to the asset where control is required.

  • Ensure that the customer's intended use of the GenFlex product is reflected in the technical onboarding solution, including the required telemetry, controls, configuration, integrations and product modules.

  • Be able to explain to customers how their site will interact with KrakenFlex, both from a physical integration perspective and from a software/product perspective.

  • Work with Product teams to identify where customer or asset requirements do not fit current product capabilities, and ensure gaps, constraints or product dependencies are surfaced early.

  • Feed recurring onboarding challenges, customer requirements and technical integration pain points back into Product and Engineering teams to help improve and scale the GenFlex proposition.

  • Be the primary delivery point of contact for customers during site onboarding, setting clear expectations around what we need from them, what Kraken is delivering and what needs to happen next.

  • Work closely with our Electrical Engineering and Customer Success Engineering teams to ensure the technical information required to integrate a site is complete, accurate and available at the right stage of delivery.

  • Review and interpret customer technical documentation including:

    • Electrical Single Line Diagrams (SLDs)

    • Network and communications diagrams

    • Site and asset specifications

    • PPC and controller documentation

    • Modbus register maps

    • IP addressing and network information

    • Functional Design Specifications

    • Metering and telemetry information

    • Hardware and connectivity requirements

  • Be confident discussing technical site architecture with customers and engineers, understanding how equipment such as generators, batteries, meters, PPCs, controllers, gateways and site networks fit together.

  • Identify missing, inconsistent or technically unclear customer information early and drive it to resolution before it becomes a delivery blocker.

  • Coordinate the preparation and review of Kraken integration documentation, including gateway architecture, communications diagrams, Kraken SLDs, integration designs and site configuration information.

  • Coordinate the Kraken Gateway delivery and installation process, ensuring prerequisites such as power, networking, connectivity and installation arrangements are understood and ready.

  • Manage readiness for key commissioning and testing activities, including:

    • Gateway installation and connectivity

    • Operational acceptance testing

    • Kraken market and service testing

  • Proactively manage delivery risks and communicate issues and mitigation plans clearly to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Surface blockers early and drive the right people together to resolve them rather than allowing issues to sit between teams.

  • Maintain clear visibility of the status and health of each site, including technical readiness, product readiness, customer actions, Kraken actions and upcoming milestones.

  • Continuously improve the Generation Flex onboarding process, identifying recurring technical, product or customer blockers and working with Engineering, Product and Operations teams to remove them.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

  • A strong technical background and the confidence to work closely with electrical, control systems, and networking.

  • A practical understanding of industrial networking and communications, including concepts such as IP addressing, LANs, routers, switches, VPNs and site connectivity.

  • Enough electrical engineering knowledge to understand concepts such as metering, breakers, transformers, generators, inverters, batteries and asset control systems.

  • Experience delivering technical projects involving the integration, commissioning or onboarding of physical assets, ideally within energy, renewables, utilities, industrial automation, controls or a similar environment.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to take a complicated technical problem and clearly explain the issue, impact, owner and next action.

  • Experience coordinating multiple teams and dependencies across customers, Electrical Engineering, hardware, installation partners and other third parties.

  • A highly organised approach to delivery, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple sites at different stages of onboarding simultaneously.

  • The ability to proactively identify risk, remove blockers and maintain momentum in an environment where customer readiness and site timelines can change quickly.

  • A customer-centric mindset and a drive to provide an outstanding onboarding experience without compromising technical quality.

  • A pragmatic, collaborative approach and the confidence to operate in a fast-moving environment where processes and products are still evolving.

  • A strong interest in understanding how a SaaS product works end-to-end, rather than treating the software platform as a black box.

  • A drive to get things done in a collaborative, agile environment, comfortable navigating the complexity and comfortable being the regional face of site onboarding function.

  • Language: professional fluency in German and English

⭐ Bonus points

  • Experience in APIs, data flows, system integrations or cloud software architecture would be beneficial.

  • Experience in flexible generation, battery storage, renewable energy, demand response or distributed energy resources.

  • A working understanding of industrial communication protocols and controlled environments would be helpful (e.g. modbus, OPC UA

  • Experience commissioning or integrating generators, BESS, solar, EV infrastructure or other industrial energy assets.

  • Previous experience working with grid-connected assets, control systems or energy market services.

  • Experience with SaaS implementation, technical product onboarding or systems integration.

  • Familiarity with commissioning processes and the distinction between cold commissioning, energisation and hot commissioning.

  • Experience with industrial gateways, edge devices or IoT connectivity.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Compliance & Recording
jobs.description:
About Us

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider helping enterprises and consumer brands deliver seamless connectivity worldwide. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform, proprietary eSIM technology, and its own mobile core network across 15 countries, 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider in 43 countries.


Founded in 2022, 1GLOBAL has rapidly become one of Europe's fastest-growing telecom technology companies, connecting more than 80 million people and devices globally. Our customers include leading banks, multinational enterprises, global retailers, travel companies, payment service providers, and digital-first businesses.


Headquartered in the Netherlands, with R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 550 professionals across 16 countries. With annual revenues exceeding US$200 million and a strong track record of profitability, we continue to invest in innovation, infrastructure, and international expansion as we redefine the future of global mobile connectivity.

About the Team

The Compliance & Recording team owns 1GLOBAL's products for regulated enterprises. We capture mobile voice, SMS and data at network level, with no app on the device, and deliver it to wherever our customers need it: their own on-site recorders and archives, or our Cloud Compliance service built on Verint Financial Compliance. On top of the recordings we offer Communications Analytics, which brings AI transcription, summaries and risk insights to compliance teams.

Our customers include 8 of the world's 10 largest banks. They rely on us for a complete, auditable record of every regulated call and message, so reliability and precision are at the heart of everything the team builds. We work closely with engineering, network, security, service delivery and commercial teams.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own how recorded communications are captured, delivered and analysed. This is an API-first, backend role: there is little UI at its core, because for our customers the integration is the product.

About the Role

You will lead product strategy and delivery for Compliance & Recording, from the APIs and delivery channels that move recorded data into customer environments to the AI capabilities we build on top of it. 

  • Own the vision, roadmap and backlog for Compliance & Recording, covering customer-managed (on-site) recording, Cloud Compliance and the integrations that connect them to customer systems.
  • Define and evolve how recorded voice, SMS and data reach customers through APIs, SFTP, SMTP and S3 bucket pushes, choosing the right mechanism for each use case.
  • Write precise technical requirements: API contracts, payload and metadata schemas, delivery guarantees, retry and failure handling, security controls and acceptance criteria.
  • Lead large projects for our biggest compliance customers, onboarding their engineering and compliance teams with proper documentation, from scoping through rollout.
  • Define and track success metrics such as delivery success rate, latency, capture completeness and time to integrate, and keep the roadmap aligned with regulatory change and the competitive landscape.

Requirements

About You

Must Have

  • 6+ years in product management, with end-to-end ownership of API-first, backend or platform products where there is little or no UI.
  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of APIs: REST design, authentication, versioning, webhooks, pagination, error handling and idempotency. You read OpenAPI specs, test endpoints yourself and hold your own in design discussions with engineers.
  • Solid understanding of file and message-based integrations such as SFTP, SMTP and object storage (for example AWS S3), including batch versus near real-time delivery, encryption and access control.
  • A track record of leading large, cross-functional projects for enterprise customers with demanding technical, security and reliability requirements.
  • Clear, precise writing: requirements, acceptance criteria and edge cases that engineering teams can build from without guesswork.
  • A genuine interest in compliance products and enterprise integrations. You want to understand how regulated firms capture, retain and supervise communications, and why every record matters.
  • Confident communication with engineers, customer technical teams, compliance officers and executives, in fluent written and spoken English.


Nice to Have

  • Telecom experience, for example mobile voice and SMS, MVNO platforms, SIP, call recording or CDRs.
  • Compliance or regtech experience, such as communications recording, archiving or surveillance.
  • Experience shipping AI features in production, such as speech-to-text, LLM evaluation or human-in-the-loop review.

Benefits

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 50% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.


1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

jobs.description:
Product Manager – Agent Experience

Lieu : Paris de préférence, possibilité à Londres (hybride, trois jours par semaine au bureau)
Équipe : Customer Care
Langues : Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais
Contrat : CDI

À noter : ce poste est ouvert à Paris et à Londres, et nécessite un droit de travailler déjà acquis dans le pays où vous serez basé(e) (UE pour Paris, Royaume-Uni pour Londres). Nous ne pouvons pas proposer de parrainage de visa, mais nous étudions le parrainage poste par poste : gardez un œil sur notre site carrières pour de futures opportunités.

Merci de soumettre votre CV en anglais.

À propos de Kaluza

Kaluza est la plateforme d’Energy Intelligence qui transforme la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les énergéticiens à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié.

Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel entre les foyers, les appareils, les marchés et les réseaux. En associant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie de tous les jours.

Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des entreprises innovantes comme Volvo et Volkswagen.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Piloter la roadmap : porter la stratégie de bout en bout de Kaluza Agent Experience (KAE) sur le marché européen, en cohérence avec les objectifs produit globaux et affinée par les besoins clients locaux et les comportements des agents. Vous suivrez les indicateurs opérationnels clés (AHT, FCR, CSAT, adoption de l’IA, onboarding) pour vous assurer que chaque évolution améliore l’expérience des agents et des clients.

  • Concevoir les parcours et garantir la cohérence UX : être le garant de l’expérience agent sur l’ensemble de KAE. Vous travaillerez avec les équipes UX et métier pour appliquer des patterns communs, réduire la charge cognitive des agents et rester aligné avec le design system, y compris quand de nouvelles capacités d’automatisation et d’assistance par l’IA sont introduites.

  • Mener les intégrations et l’onboarding client : piloter les intégrations techniques et produit avec des plateformes tierces, et superviser de bout en bout le déploiement de nouvelles instances KAE pour les nouveaux clients, de la phase de découverte jusqu’à la mise en production.

  • Garantir l’accessibilité et la conformité : défendre les réglementations européennes d’accessibilité dès la conception, en traduisant les exigences réglementaires et spécifiques à chaque marché en besoins techniques concrets.

  • Accompagner les clients et créer de la valeur : être l’expert de confiance des clients sur l’expérience agent, en défendant une configuration native de la plateforme plutôt que des développements sur mesure.

  • Rester les mains dans le cambouis, de la livraison à l’accompagnement : vous impliquer sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie du développement produit (PDLC), des sessions de discovery avec les agents aux boucles de feedback, et produire les supports qui favorisent l’adoption côté clients.

(À noter : des déplacements chez les clients, par exemple à Bruxelles, sont à prévoir, environ 1 à 3 par mois au début, puis 1 à 2 par trimestre.)

Ce que vous apporterez

Idéalement, vous avez :

  • Une expertise centres de contact et UX : une solide expérience de la responsabilité de parcours utilisateurs de bout en bout pour des outils opérationnels très sollicités (par exemple des postes de travail d’agents), avec une vraie pratique de la recherche utilisateur, de la cartographie de parcours et des tests d’usabilité auprès d’agents et de superviseurs.

  • Une connaissance de l’accessibilité européenne et de l’intégration de plateformes : une bonne maîtrise des standards d’accessibilité européens, ainsi qu’une expérience avérée d’intégration de produits avec des plateformes tierces et des écosystèmes de fournisseurs complexes.

  • Une expérience de delivery client et d’expansion de marché : un historique de mise en œuvre ou de localisation d’un produit pour des clients entreprise externes, en menant les solutions de zéro à la mise en production : discovery, configuration et conduite du changement.

  • Un jugement fondé sur la donnée et de l’influence : la capacité démontrée à vous appuyer sur des indicateurs opérationnels (AHT, FCR, CSAT, effort de l’agent) pour défendre vos décisions produit, avec un état d’esprit « plateforme d’abord » qui privilégie les capacités existantes au code sur mesure.

  • Un bilinguisme professionnel : une maîtrise complète, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, du français et de l’anglais.

Ce qui fera la différence

  • Une expérience de l’utilisation d’outils d’IA, de capacités de machine learning ou d’intégrations LLM dans des workflows produit, pour renforcer l’intelligence de la plateforme et l’automatisation directement dans les environnements de poste de travail du service client.

  • Une expérience dans des plateformes SaaS, le secteur de l’énergie ou des migrations d’envergure chez des opérateurs de services publics.

Où vous travaillerez

jobs.title: Senior Scrum master
jobs.description:
Niet faciliteren om te faciliteren. Maar teams helpen slimmer samen te werken.

AI verandert de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen. Maar nieuwe technologie alleen maakt een team nog niet beter. Daarvoor heb je iemand nodig die mensen verbindt, samenwerking versterkt en verandering écht in beweging krijgt.

Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We bouwen aan moderne software, slimme dataplatformen en agentic oplossingen. Tegelijkertijd kijken we hoe AI onze eigen manier van werken verandert.

Daarom zoeken we een Scrum Master die verder kijkt dan Scrum events. Iemand die begrijpt dat Agile niet allen draait om ceremonies, maar ook om waarde toevoegen,  wendbaarheid, eigenaarschap en samenwerking.

Jouw rol

Als Scrum Master begeleid je multidisciplinaire teams die werken aan complexe softwareprojecten, data-oplossingen en AI-first applicaties.

Je helpt teams om beter samen te werken, obstakels weg te nemen en continu te verbeteren. Je bent een stevige gesprekspartner voor de organisatie, developers, product owners en stakeholders en weet wanneer je moet coachen, uitdagen of juist ruimte moet geven.

Maar je kijkt ook vooruit.

Wat betekent AI voor de manier waarop teams software ontwikkelen? Hoe kunnen AI-developmenttools en agentic workflows bijdragen aan kwaliteit, snelheid en samenwerking? En hoe zorg je dat teams nieuwe technologie omarmen zonder hun focus op mensen en resultaat te verliezen?

Je hoeft niet zelf te programmeren, maar je bent nieuwsgierig naar technologie en begrijpt hoe veranderingen in software engineering invloed en impact hebben op de organisatie, teams en processen. 

Wat ga je doen?

  • Coachen van Agile-teams op focus, samenwerking, communicatie en voorspelbaarheid

  • Faciliteren van Scrum-events die daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan verbetering

  • Signaleren en wegnemen van blokkades binnen teams en binnen de organisatie

  • Versterken van de samenwerking tussen developers, product owners, business en stakeholders.

  • Meedenken over de inzet van AI-tools om teamprocessen, kennisdeling, delivery en adoptie slimmer te organiseren.

  • Continu verbeteren van flow, kwaliteit en de manier waarop teams waarde leveren.

  • Bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Agile-werkwijze binnen een AI First-organisatie.


  • Minimaal 7 jaar ervaring als Scrum Master binnen softwareontwikkeling.

  • Ervaring met multidisciplinaire teams in complexe IT-omgevingen.

  • Sterke kennis van Agile, Scrum en teamontwikkeling.

  • PSM I en II, CSM- of vergelijkbare certificering.

  • Interesse in AI, automatisering en de veranderende wereld van software engineering.

  • Het vermogen om teams, product owners te coachen, stakeholders uit te dagen en verandering te begeleiden.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels.

  • Ervaring met SAFe, LeSS of andere scaling frameworks is een pré.

Je hoeft geen AI-expert te zijn. We zoeken vooral iemand die nieuwsgierig is naar de impact van AI op samenwerking en softwareontwikkeling en teams daarin kan meenemen.

Het team

Je komt terecht in een team van zo’n 25 gedreven medior en senior developers. We zijn groot genoeg om serieuze projecten neer te zetten en klein genoeg om elkaar te kennen. Iedereen heeft invloed en goede ideeën worden niet alleen gehoord, maar ook uitgeprobeerd.

We zetten onze development expertise in bij gerenommeerde bedrijven in Nederland. Daar bouwen we met Java en Kotlin aan oplossingen die ertoe doen, en we gebruiken AI om tot de best mogelijke resultaten te komen. We onderzoeken continu hoe AI ons werk en dat van onze klanten slimmer kan maken.

Ontwikkeling staat voorop. Tijdens onze kennisavonden delen we wat we leren en we bezoeken jaarlijks (inter)nationale conferenties om scherp te blijven. Daarnaast spreken we regelmatig af voor informele activiteiten, want goed samenwerken begint met elkaar écht kennen.

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen.

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI First: samen bouwen aan de toekomst

Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We geloven dat AI de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen, met data werken en klanten helpen fundamenteel verandert.

Daarom kijken we verder dan losse AI-experimenten. We bouwen aan slimme dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die écht onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat betekent ook dat we onze eigen manier van werken blijven vernieuwen. We omarmen nieuwe technologie, maar blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.

 
En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • Een salaris van €4.500,- tot €5.750,- afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • 8% vakantiegeld;

  • Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week;

  • Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding boven op je salaris;

  • 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen;

  • €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen;

  • Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden;

  • Goede pensioenregeling;

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden;

  • Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team.

jobs.title: Senior Strategy & Project Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Als Senior Strategy & Project Manager im Management Office verantwortest du eigenständig strategische Projekte mit hohem Business Impact und unterstützt primär unsere Geschäftsführung als analytischer Sparringspartner bei zentralen unternehmerischen Fragestellungen. Du treibst High-Impact-Initiativen voran, behältst die relevanten KPIs im Blick und trägst so unmittelbar zur erfolgreichen Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung von LIQID bei.

Diese Position bietet eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, tiefgehende Einblicke in das Management und die verschiedensten Bereiche eines der innovativsten Scale-Ups im Bereich Financial Services zu gewinnen und direkten Einfluss auf die Weiterentwicklung von LIQID zu nehmen.

Die Stelle ist ab sofort zu besetzen. Aufgrund der Nähe zum Senior Management ist eine hohe Präsenz im Berliner Büro Voraussetzung.


Was machst du dabei konkret?

  • Strategische Projekte: Du leitest High-Impact-Initiativen end-to-end, treibst deren Umsetzung voran und bist dabei inhaltlich tief in den Themen involviert, um die bestmöglichen Lösungen zu erarbeiten.

  • Datenbasierte Entscheidungsfindung: Du hast einen Blick auf alle relevanten KPIs, leitest fundierte Empfehlungen ab und trägst dazu bei, datengetriebene Entscheidungen zu treffen. Für unsere Geschäftsführung bist du dabei ein Key Sparrings Partner.

  • Business Impact & strategische Analysen: Du erstellst Entscheidungsgrundlagen, Business Cases und Analysen zu zentralen strategischen Fragestellungen und stellst sicher, dass strategische Prioritäten effizient umgesetzt werden.

  • Business Transformation: Du identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale in Prozessen und Strukturen innerhalb eines oder über Teams hinweg und treibst die kontinuierliche organisatorische Weiterentwicklung.

  • Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit den Executive und Leadership Teams sowie den Fachbereichen zusammen, koordinierst über Teamgrenzen hinweg und sorgst für eine reibungslose Umsetzung.

  • Stakeholder Management: Du bist eine zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen unserem CEO, der Geschäftsführung und externen Stakeholdern. Du pflegst du den Kontakt zu Partnern und Investoren, bereitest Updates und Unterlagen vor und unterstützt den CEO und die Geschäftsführung bei strategischen Diskussionen.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Akademischer Background: Ein exzellenter Abschluss einer Top-Tier Business School, Wirtschafts- oder Technischen Universität mit Schwerpunkt auf Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Management oder angrenzenden Bereichen.

  • Berufserfahrung: mind. 5 Jahre relevante Erfahrung im Bereich Strategieberatung, Investment Banking, Private Equity oder Venture Capital bzw. in einer vergleichbaren strategischen Rolle (idealerweise mit Bezug zu Financial Services oder Tech Scale-Ups).

  • Projektmanagement: Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Leitung und Umsetzung komplexer Projekte mit mehreren Stakeholdern.

  • Analytische & strategische Fähigkeiten: Eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe, ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Zahlen und ein hohes Maß an Detailorientierung.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Ausgezeichnete Fähigkeiten in schriftlicher und mündlicher Kommunikation auf deutschsprachigem Muttersprachniveau sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Eigeninitiative, Durchsetzungsvermögen und die Fähigkeit, in einem dynamischen Umfeld pragmatische Lösungen zu finden.

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Vielfalt: Flache Hierarchien und kulturelle Offenheit machen dich ab Tag 1 zum integralen Bestandteil unseres bunten Teams aus internationalen Talenten.

  • Flexibilität: Wir machen dein Leben nicht kompliziert. In flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen, Arbeitszeiten und Mobile-Working-Regelungen findest du die richtige Balance. 28 Tage Urlaub und 2 zusätzliche freie Tage am 24. und 31.12. verschaffen dir zudem entspannte Auszeiten.

  • Wertschätzung: Du gestaltest mit uns die Zukunft des digitalen Wealth Managements in einem innovativen, mehrfach ausgezeichneten Unternehmen auf Wachstumskurs, mit hoher Marktrelevanz und viel Raum für deine Ideen.

  • Entwicklung: Wir unterstützen deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung mit einem jährlichen Development-Budget von 1.500€. Außerdem erhältst du zu Beginn deiner Tätigkeit bei LIQID ein hochwertiges Equipment, bestehend aus MacBook, Kopfhörern und Display.

  • Smart Money: Als LIQIDian erhältst du attraktive Konditionen für unsere Anlagestrategien, einen monatlichen Lunch-Zuschuss und exklusive Discounts bei verschiedenen Anbietern.

  • Wohlbefinden: Regionale Bio-Produkte halten Dich vor Ort im Office fit – und unsere Gesundheitsinitiativen oder unser Health Assistance Programm auch weit darüber hinaus.

So geht es für dich weiter

Eine ausgezeichnete Candidate Experience und Transparenz haben für uns im Interviewprozess die höchste Priorität. Die verschiedenen Bewerbungsphasen helfen uns zu verstehen, wie eine Zusammenarbeit aussehen könnte.

  • Kurzes Kennenlerngespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team: Ein entspannter erster Austausch, bei dem wir uns gegenseitig kennenlernen.

  • Videointerview mit dem Hiring Manager: Wir besprechen, ob deine Erfahrungen und Erwartungen an die Rolle zu unseren Anforderungen passen.

  • Case Study: Wir möchten sehen, wie du komplexe Herausforderungen angehst und deine Problemlösungskompetenz anhand eines realistischen Arbeitsszenarios unter Beweis stellst.

  • Persönliches Kennenlernen: Du lernst das Team kennen und erhältst praxisnahe Einblicke in den Arbeitsalltag.

Über uns

Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Dabei setzen wir auf ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mensch, Umwelt und Profit.

Wir bieten unseren Kundinnen und Kunden umfassende Anlagelösungen – von erstklassiger Vermögensverwaltung bis hin zu kuratierten Portfolios aus den weltweit besten Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Fonds. Mit einem verwalteten Vermögen von über 4 Milliarden Euro gehören wir schon jetzt zu den führenden Vermögensverwaltern in Deutschland. In unserer weiteren Entwicklung arbeiten wir mit starken und erfahrenen Partnern wie LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust und Project A zusammen.


LIQID ist ein Arbeitgeber, der für Chancengleichheit steht. Alle qualifizierten Bewerbungen werden ohne Rücksicht auf Hautfarbe, Alter, Religion, Geschlecht, ethnische und nationale Herkunft, Behinderung oder aufgrund von anderen durch Gleichbehandlungsgesetze geschützte Eigenschaften berücksichtigt.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Productization (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Die Rolle

Wir haben in den letzten Jahren gezeigt, dass wir echte Kundenprobleme lösen können. Jetzt geht es darum, aus bewährten Lösungen wiederholbare Produkte zu machen, die sich skalierbar verkaufen und liefern lassen. Genau dafür suchen wir Dich!

Du machst aus validierten Kundenlösungen skalierbare Produkte. Unser Product-Modell folgt drei Phasen: 0→1 (Kundenproblem verstehen, Lösung im Kundenfall beweisen), 1→n (daraus ein wiederholbares Produkt machen) und n (skalierbar verkaufen, liefern, weiterentwickeln).

Dein Fokus liegt auf 1→ n1→n: Du klärst, was das Produkt ist, für wen, welchen messbaren Mehrwert es liefert und wie es als Standardangebot verkauft und geliefert wird. Du verantwortest Produkt und Produktisierung – Engineering, Delivery, Sales und Product Marketing bleiben für Umsetzung, Kundenprojekt, Opportunity und Vermarktung zuständig. Darüber hinaus verantwortest Du den Lifecycle bestehender Produkte: Du sicherst ihre Stärken und Standards und entwickelst sie gezielt weiter.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Validierte Lösungen konsequent in wiederholbare, standardisierte Angebote überführen
  • Zielkunden, Pain, Business Value und Value Proposition schärfen
  • Klaren Standardumfang und klare Produktgrenzen definieren – inklusive dessen, was bewusst nicht dazugehört
  • Gemeinsam mit Engineering die notwendige Produktreife herstellen
  • Kundenfeedback pragmatisch in Produktentscheidungen übersetzen
  • Product Marketing die fachliche Grundlage für Positionierung, Messaging und Content geben
  • Sales und Presales befähigen, das Produkt ohne permanente Product-Unterstützung zu erklären und zu verkaufen
  • Delivery befähigen, Einführung und Betrieb mit kalkulierbarem Aufwand umzusetzen
  • Lifecycle, Weiterentwicklung und Priorisierung verantworten, für neu produktisierte ebenso wie für bestehende Produkte, deren Stärken und Standards es zu sichern gilt

Was Du mitbringst

  • 5+ Jahre relevante Erfahrung im Product Management im komplexen B2B- bzw. Enterprise-Software-Umfeld
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung darin, aus individuellen Kundenanforderungen, Piloten oder Prototypen ein standardisiertes, wiederholbares Produkt zu machen
  • Sehr gutes technisches Verständnis für komplexe Software-, Daten- und AI-Produkte: Du arbeitest mit Engineering auf Augenhöhe und verbindest Business, Kunde, Produkt und Technologie – ohne selbst Engineer sein zu müssen
  • Pragmatische Arbeitsweise mit starkem 80/20-Schnitt und schneller Entscheidungsfähigkeit auch bei unvollständigen Informationen, getragen von fundierter methodischer Product-Erfahrung
  • Hohe Ownership: Risiken früh erkennen und mit einer klaren Empfehlung kommen statt mit der Bitte um mehr Zeit oder Ressourcen
  • Klarer Fokus auf Business Value und Ergebnisse statt auf Prozesse, mit dem Talent, Komplexität zu reduzieren
  • Von Vorteil: Erfahrung mit Industriekunden oder Enterprise-Lösungen wie Manufacturing, PLM, ERP, SCM oder Data
  • Reisebereitschaft für Kundentermine vor Ort
  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift

Was die Rolle nicht ist

Damit Du einschätzen kannst, ob die Rolle zu Dir passt: Wir suchen bewusst nicht

  • einen klassischen Product Owner mit Schwerpunkt Backlog und Tickets,
  • einen reinen Projektmanager,
  • einen weiteren 0→1-Innovator,
  • einen Presales-Spezialisten,
  • einen reinen Strategen,
  • einen technischen Product Manager, der primär in Features und Architektur denkt.

Benefits:

  • Echte Gestaltungsverantwortung: Du prägst eine neu definierte Rolle und unser Product-Betriebsmodell für 2027 und darüber hinaus
  • Kurze Wege: direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführung, Engineering, Sales und Delivery
  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Hybrides Arbeiten, flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Modernes Umfeld: Büro im Münchner Werksviertel (House of Communication), moderne Ausstattung und internationale, diverse Teams
  • Entwicklung & Kultur: Regelmäßiges Feedback, flache Hierarchien und kollaborative Zusammenarbeit
  • Plus: Spendit Card, Urban Sports Club oder EGYM Wellpass, kostenlose Getränke, Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Kaffee & Obst sowie Team- und Office-Events

The Principal Product Manager, Acute Care CT shapes the suite from day one: owning the roadmap, translating clinical needs into ML and product work, and driving cross-functional delivery on a subset of the suite from data through customer activation. The role does not write code or own technical software design.

  • Preferred: French language skills.

  • Preferred: Acute care, stroke, or emergency imaging background.

  • Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors.

  • Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment.

  • Follows all DeepHealth policies and procedures.

  • Follows data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times.

  • Practices universal safety precautions.

  • Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person.
