jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Geef richting aan de toekomst van high-tech elektronica.

Van medische apparatuur en industriële systemen tot geavanceerde semicon-oplossingen: onze Electrical Engineers staan aan de basis van technologie die wereldwijd wordt toegepast. Ben jij de leider die energie krijgt van het ontwikkelen van mensen, kennis en technische excellence? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

 

Als Electrical Engineering Manager beweeg jij je op het snijvlak van technologie, leiderschap en organisatieontwikkeling. Daarbij richt je je niet alleen op de resultaten van vandaag, maar ook op de technische uitdagingen van morgen. Je stimuleert kennisontwikkeling, versterkt engineering excellence en helpt richting te geven aan de verdere groei van Electrical Engineering binnen Benchmark.

 

Je geeft leiding aan een team van circa 40 engineers en speel je een belangrijke rol in de verdere ontwikkeling van een van de grootste technische disciplines binnen Benchmark. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit, groei en prestaties van de organisatie en creëert een omgeving waarin engineers kunnen excelleren, innoveren en zich blijven ontwikkelen.

 

Met jouw visie op leiderschap, talentontwikkeling en technologie bouw je aan een sterke engineeringcultuur waarin vakmanschap, samenwerking en continue verbetering centraal staan. Zo zorg je ervoor dat onze Electrical Engineering-organisatie klaar blijft voor de complexe technologische vraagstukken van onze klanten én de ambities van de toekomst.

 

Jij combineert technisch leiderschap, people management en strategische ontwikkeling. Daarom ben jij verantwoordelijk voor:

  • Het aansturen, coachen en ontwikkelen van circa 40 Electrical Engineers.

  • Het leiden van de AI-transformatie binnen Electrical Engineering.

  • Het neerzetten van een duidelijke visie op Electrical Engineering en het vertalen hiervan naar de praktijk.

  • Het stimuleren van innovatie, kennisontwikkeling en technische excellentie binnen het vakgebied.

  • Het ontwikkelen van competenties, groeipaden en vakmanschap binnen jouw team.

  • Het bewaken van de kwaliteit, capaciteit en inzetbaarheid van de afdeling.

  • Het ondersteunen en adviseren van Program Managers bij complexe ontwikkelprojecten.

  • Het aantrekken, selecteren en ontwikkelen van technisch talent.

  • Het versterken van de samenwerking met internationale engineering teams binnen Benchmark.

  • Het bijdragen aan organisatie brede besluitvorming als onderdeel van het Competence Management Team en aan een lerende organisatie waarin kennisdeling, ontwikkeling en continue verbetering centraal staan.

 

Samen met de managers van Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering en Test Development Engineering werk je aan de verdere ontwikkeling van de totale engineeringorganisatie. Daarnaast werk je nauw samen met collega’s uit andere disciplines, waaronder HR. Omdat het aantrekken en ontwikkelen van talent in deze schaarse arbeidsmarkt essentieel is, beschik je over een sterk professioneel netwerk en weet je talent aan je team en organisatie te verbinden.

 

Waarom deze functie?

Deze rol biedt de unieke kans om invloed uit te oefenen op zowel de technische richting als de ontwikkeling van een grote groep professionals. Je werkt in een omgeving waar complexe technologie, internationale samenwerking en persoonlijke groei samenkomen.

 

Wat biedt Benchmark?

Bij Benchmark werk je aan producten die ertoe doen! Daarnaast zijn wij bij uitstek een organisatie waar je vrijheid krijgt, waar ondernemerschap wordt beloond en waarin je de ruimte krijgt om je ideeën tot uitvoering te brengen. We bieden je een dynamische omgeving met de ruimte om snel stappen te maken, door te groeien en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Je bent onderdeel van een wereldwijd bedrijf waar de nuchtere Twentse cultuur bewaard is gebleven.

 

Bij ons krijg je uitdagend werk, veel vertrouwen en ruimte om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen. Je werkt met nuchtere collega’s in een informele cultuur, met goede voorwaarden om duurzaam te presteren.

 

Daarnaast bieden wij:

  • Een aantrekkelijk salaris passend bij de verantwoordelijkheden en het potentieel binnen de rol.

  • Een bonusregeling gekoppeld aan de prestaties van jouw team en de organisatie.

  • Een managementcontract met veel ruimte voor ondernemerschap, eigen verantwoordelijkheid en impact op de verdere ontwikkeling van de organisatie.

  • Persoonlijke groei en ontwikkeling, waarbij we samen een ontwikkelpad creëren dat aansluit op jouw ambities en de behoeften van de organisatie.

  • Flexibiliteit in de inrichting van je werkweek, met ruimte om werk en privé op een manier te combineren die voor jou werkt.

  • Een sterk kennisgedreven engineeringklimaat, waarin samenwerking, kennisdeling en innovatie centraal staan. Via initiatieven zoals Lunch & Learn-sessies en Pitch Discovery Sessions krijg je volop ruimte om te leren, te inspireren en nieuwe ideeën te ontwikkelen.

 

Wie ben jij?

Of je nu een ervaren engineering manager bent of toe bent aan je eerste grotere leiderschapsrol, jij krijgt energie van technologie én het ontwikkelen van mensen. Je weet professionals te verbinden, richting te geven en samen resultaten te behalen in een complexe high-tech omgeving. Met jouw technische achtergrond, nieuwsgierigheid en leiderschapspotentieel bouw je mee aan de volgende generatie engineers én innovaties. Je combineert flexibiliteit met een sterke interesse in technologie, bent van nature nieuwsgierig en floreert in een agile omgeving. Herken jij jezelf hierin? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

 

Daarnaast zien wij graag:

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in embedded software, elektrotechniek, natuurkunde  of een vergelijkbare technische richting.

  • Je hebt een stevige achtergrond in electrical engineering en voldoende technische diepgang om met engineers en architecten te sparren over technische keuzes en ontwikkelrichtingen.

  • Minimaal zeven jaar ervaring binnen een hightech-ontwikkelomgeving, inclusief enkele jaren in een leidinggevende rol of een technische leiderschapsrol.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het aansturen, coachen en ontwikkelen van engineeringteams binnen een complexe technische organisatie.

  • Het vermogen om technische visie, organisatiedoelstellingen en talentontwikkeling succesvol met elkaar te verbinden.

  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en een goede beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal.

 

Serious Tech
Bij Benchmark werk je voor bedrijven die impact maken met hun innovaties. Zo ontwikkelen we nieuwe producten die de veiligheid of gezondheid verbeteren of juist het gemak vergroten. Deze producten worden geleverd vanaf het productontwerp tot en met volumeproductie en soms ook rechtstreeks aan de eindgebruiker. Dit gehele proces wordt geheel in Almelo uitgevoerd, waar we samenwerken met ongeveer 650 collega’s

 

We werken aan innovaties voor, onder andere, semicon, gezondheidszorg, aerospace en industrie. Van productontwerp tot volumeproductie: het hele proces komt hier samen. Technisch ligt de lat hoog, maar de cultuur blijft nuchter en dichtbij. Je werkt met mensen die verantwoordelijkheid nemen, elkaar helpen en samen willen blijven verbeteren.

About The Company

At NaroIQ, we believe the fund industry is undergoing a structural shift: investors are more cost-conscious and transparency-driven than ever, and ETFs are a natural outcome of this shift.

Yet many capital management companies (ManCos) excel at running traditional mutual funds - but struggle to enter the ETF market. Launching and operating ETFs adds a new layer of complexity: new partners, interfaces, processes, and systems that most existing setups weren't built for.

NaroIQ gives ManCos a fast, reliable path into the ETF market. We provide the digital ETF infrastructure that reduces operational complexity, so ManCos can launch and run ETFs at scale and compete effectively, helping broaden access to the market beyond dominant, US-based providers.

We are remote-first, with in-person collaboration opportunities. We work with international clients and have raised over $10m from top-tier investors and operators across finance and technology.

The Role and What Makes It Special

You own the two functions that decide how the outside world experiences NaroIQ: How we are perceived in the market, and who we manage to attract to build it. Marketing and Employer Branding sit together in one role at NaroIQ because the same narrative - sharp, technical, high quality - has to land with senior executives and journalists as well as with the engineers, operators and commercial talent we want to hire next.

This is a hands-on, individual contributor role. You will not manage a team of specialists who do the work - you'll do the work: drafting the LinkedIn post, creating our brand strategy, building relationships with journalists, organizing events, designing an employer brand. And you'll build the systems that let NaroIQ scale this without losing sharpness.

There is no marketing playbook to inherit and nobody above you in the function. You set the priorities, decide what not to do, and carry the call. That takes unusual self-drive - the kind where nobody has to ask you for a status update, and where an unclear brief is something you resolve rather than escalate.

You report to the CEO (Chris) and work in tight loops with Growth, Product and the leadership team. Over time, you have the opportunity to grow the function around you.

Tasks

What You'll Do

PR & Events

  • Run PR campaigns end-to-end, directly and with external PR partners, to build durable credibility and secure consistent placements in tier-1 outlets (Handelsblatt, Bloomberg, FT) and the FinTech and asset-management publications that matter
  • Build and maintain a working network of journalists and editors; develop narratives that sharpen NaroIQ's positioning
  • Plan and coordinate events and speaking slots (e.g. Money20/20, FinTech and asset-management conferences, exclusive industry roundtables)

Content & Brand

  • Build a scalable content and thought-leadership engine that actively supports sales enablement and pipeline progression
  • Grow NaroIQ's organic LinkedIn presence at the company and founder level. A steady cadence of substantive posts, not noise.
  • Build and maintain a consistent brand identity across every surface: website, pitch deck, one-pagers, careers page, sales collateral
  • Create a brand that sticks with our audience: You decide how we are perceived in the market and what the NaroIQ storyline should look like

Demand Generation & Sales Alignment

  • Develop the materials that prepare and accelerate enterprise conversations: one-pagers, decks, whitepapers, case studies
  • Build and run inbound growth motions: SEO, AI search optimization, and targeted growth experiments
  • Close the loop with Sales: instrument what's working, kill what isn't, feed campaign learnings back into product and positioning

Employer Branding

  • Build NaroIQ's employer brand into a real asset: a careers narrative that pulls senior talent in, a candidate experience that earns referrals
  • Position NaroIQ as one of the most attractive places to work in European FinTech; through content, events, founder presence, and glimpses into the lived experience of the team

Requirements

What We're Looking For

(You don't need to know it all - but you should be ready to dive in, learn fast, and take initiative.)

  • Experience in B2B marketing: Ideally in financial services or at an AI / enterprise startup
  • You can create a brand, not just run one: you've built positioning and narrative for a product or category, ideally while the product was still moving
  • Creative and strong at storytelling: You can draft an explanatory case study, a press pitch that lands, and a job description that pulls. Without slipping into FinTech buzzwords
  • Extroverted and a strong communicator: You build real relationships with journalists, candidates and event coordinators
  • Existing PR network or demonstrable track record in media work is a big plus
  • Data-driven: You think in KPIs and processes, and use them to make the work sharper
  • Experimental: You actively try new channels and formats, like AI search, new social formats, distribution plays
  • You treat candidates as an audience: you can write a role description that makes people apply, shape how NaroIQ shows up to talent, and equip hiring managers with a story worth telling
  • A taste-led approach to brand: you can hold a consistent visual and verbal system across surfaces and push back on output that breaks it
  • Structured and genuinely self-directed: you're comfortable operating with ambiguity, high ownership and no cover in a small, fast-moving team
  • Fluent in English and German, written and spoken

Nice to have: existing relationships with FinTech or asset-management journalists; experience building a careers brand from scratch; familiarity with growth tooling (SEO, attribution, growth-hacking stacks).

Why NaroIQ

We're building something ambitious - and we believe the only way to do that is with a team that's low-ego, high-impact, and genuinely excited about what they're doing.

Here's what we care about:

🔑 High Ownership
We trust you to take full responsibility for your work. That means freedom and also being the person others rely on when things get real.

🚫 No Bullshit, No Ego
We're too small for politics, posturing or competing agendas. We care about doing the right thing, not being right.

🧘‍♂️ Flexibility
Exceptional work doesn't require relocation or fixed office hours. Have dinner with your family. Get that dog. Move to the Alps. We're remote-first and trust people to manage their own time.

🧳 Sometimes We Leave the House
We do make time for real-life moments, like quarterly offsites or in-person team sessions, to solve stuff together or just hang out.

🦸🏻‍♀️ Hire for Spikes
We don't expect you to be good at everything. We care about your superpower. We're building a team of nerds who are world-class in wildly different areas.

🛠 Default to Rethink
We don't accept "that's just how it is." We dig deep, think from scratch and always believe there's a better way. First Principles isn't a buzzword for us.

💅🏼 Give Yourself a Little Treat
We offer benefits via hrmony, so you can spend up to €50/month on the little things that bring you joy: Urban Sports, DAZN, Mediamarkt, Thalia, whatever suits you.

🤓 Your Learning Curve is Our Investment
Everyone at NaroIQ gets €1,000 per year for courses, books, coaching, or whatever helps them grow.

  • Decide the change approach for the programme: stakeholder analysis, change impact assessment, training design and business readiness engagement, shaped to ENGIE France’s operating context and owned by their teams.

  • Operate Kaluza’s business readiness governance: stage gates, readiness evidence, risk and dependency tracking and weekly reporting.

  • Partner with the Learning and Adoption Specialist in France to coordinate training, Train the Trainer and knowledge content, so enablement lands throughout each programme increment as we build out and release features via Agile delivery.

Responsable Conduite du changement et Transformation – Client Delivery (Français/Anglais)

Merci de noter : ce poste est basé en France, vous devez y résider ou envisager de vous y installer, et il nécessite un droit de travail existant dans l’UE. Nous ne pouvons pas proposer de sponsoring de visa, mais nous étudions cette possibilité poste par poste, alors n’hésitez pas à consulter régulièrement notre site carrières pour découvrir de futures opportunités.

Le français et l’anglais courants (à l’oral comme à l’écrit) sont indispensables, et nous vous remercions de soumettre votre CV en anglais.

À propos de Kaluza

Kaluza est la plateforme d’Energy Intelligence qui transforme la complexité du secteur de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les entreprises de l’énergie à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié.

Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel entre les foyers, les appareils, les marchés et les réseaux. En combinant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie quotidienne.

Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des entreprises innovantes comme Volvo et Volkswagen.

Vos missions

  • Piloter, en tant que référent(e) opérationnel(le), l’accompagnement du changement et de la transformation pour la préparation au go-live de la migration d’ENGIE France sur Kaluza, de la planification jusqu’à la bascule, l’hypercare et la transition vers le déploiement à plus grande échelle, afin que les équipes d’ENGIE soient prêtes et confiantes pour adopter la plateforme dès le premier jour.

  • Définir l’approche de conduite du changement du programme : analyse des parties prenantes, évaluation des impacts du changement, conception des formations et mobilisation pour la préparation métier, adaptées au contexte opérationnel d’ENGIE France et portées par leurs équipes.

  • Faire vivre la gouvernance de préparation métier de Kaluza : stage gates, preuves de préparation, suivi des risques et des dépendances, et reporting hebdomadaire.

  • Collaborer avec le ou la Learning and Adoption Specialist en France pour coordonner la formation, le Train the Trainer et les contenus de connaissance, afin que l’accompagnement soit en place à chaque incrément du programme, au fil de la construction et de la livraison des fonctionnalités en mode Agile.

  • Être l’interlocuteur(trice) quotidien(ne) d’ENGIE France sur la préparation métier, le changement et l’adoption, en apportant des conseils pratiques à leurs responsables de transformation.

  • Suivre l’adoption et la stabilité opérationnelle pendant l’hypercare, analyser les causes racines de tout écart par rapport aux critères d’acceptation, et convenir avec ENGIE des actions correctives.

  • Améliorer le playbook de préparation de Kaluza : faire évoluer ce qui a fonctionné sur ENGIE Belgique, tester des correctifs là où cela ne suffit pas en France, et partager vos enseignements avec vos collègues de Client Delivery pour façonner les fondations opérationnelles de la plateforme, ses améliorations et nos standards globaux.

Au quotidien, vous piloterez ou soutiendrez notamment les activités suivantes :

  • Impacts du changement et planification de la préparation : diagnostiquer l’ensemble des impacts sur les rôles, les processus, les systèmes et l’expérience client, puis les traduire en un plan de préparation priorisé, séquencé en fonction du rythme de livraison, de migration et de mise en production.

  • Parties prenantes, sponsors et réseaux du changement : cartographier les parties prenantes et leur influence au niveau de chaque chantier, aider les sponsors à rester visibles et engagés, et structurer les réseaux de champions, de super-utilisateurs et de managers qui porteront le changement au sein du business d’ENGIE.

  • Communication et résistances : soutenir la stratégie de communication et d’engagement d’ENGIE France, afin que leurs équipes et leurs clients entendent un discours cohérent et positif sur le programme. Vous aiderez les dirigeants et les champions à porter le changement, en interne comme auprès des clients, et vous anticiperez les zones où des résistances pourraient apparaître afin d’intervenir avant qu’elles ne s’installent.

  • Migration et préparation au go-live : constituer les preuves de préparation métier et opérationnelle qui permettent un transfert fluide vers l’exploitation, mesurées par rapport aux critères d’acceptation convenus, et soutenir le centre de commandement du go-live.

  • Hypercare et stabilisation : définir les critères d’entrée et de sortie de l’hypercare, suivre les signaux de stabilité et d’adoption, et assurer une passation propre aux équipes d’exploitation d’ENGIE.

  • Premières versions et solutions de contournement : anticiper les limitations connues des premières versions et les refléter dans les formations, les contenus de connaissance et les communications, pour que les utilisateurs ne soient jamais pris au dépourvu. Vous travaillerez avec le Release Management pour que chaque version de la plateforme arrive avec l’accompagnement nécessaire.

Votre profil

Idéalement, vous avez :

  • Plusieurs années d’expérience opérationnelle en conduite du changement sur de grandes transformations de plateformes ou de systèmes, avec une discipline de change management reconnue. Vous résolvez avec créativité une grande variété de problèmes et travaillez avec peu de supervision.

  • Une expérience dans des environnements opérationnels régulés et en contact avec les clients, incluant la migration de comptes clients en production, la bascule et le go-live, où vous avez contribué à définir l’approche plutôt que de simplement en suivre une.

  • De solides compétences en communication et en gestion des parties prenantes, avec une vraie crédibilité auprès des responsables de programme et des sponsors de transformation côté client.

  • Une aisance avec les données : vous explorez vous-même les données d’adoption et de programme, vous en rendez compte clairement et vous challengez les décisions lorsque les éléments factuels sont fragiles.

  • Une sensibilité commerciale : vous comprenez comment Kaluza gagne de l’argent et savez arbitrer entre les besoins du client et les coûts, en travaillant aux côtés des partenaires intégrateurs et des ressources change du client, sans doublonner les efforts.

Ce qui fera la différence : une expérience dans la vente d’énergie aux particuliers ou dans les utilities, une expérience côté éditeur sur une implémentation SaaS, et/ou une connaissance des opérations et des technologies de centre de contact.

Nos valeurs

Cinq valeurs guident notre façon de travailler chez Kaluza :

  • Jouer pour gagner : La fierté collective de décarboner l’énergie à grande échelle.

  • Résoudre le vrai problème : Aller au-delà de la complexité pour se concentrer sur des résultats concrets.

  • Bâtir la confiance chaque jour : Cohérence, transparence et tenir parole.

  • Assumer les résultats : Une pleine responsabilité, dans les réussites comme dans les revers, sans ego.

  • Aller plus loin ensemble : Collaboration, respect et diversité des points de vue.

Nos avantages

  • Finance & assurances : Bonus discrétionnaire, mutuelle santé Alan, assurance Vie & Décès x3 (prévoyance) via Alan, et cotisations standard de Sécurité Sociale (retraite, allocations familiales, assurance chômage)

  • Indemnités : Remboursement de 50 % des frais de transport, indemnité de télétravail de 200 € et budget formation de 150 €

  • Congés & flexibilité : 25 jours de congés payés + jours fériés + jours de RTT, congé Moments Importants, congé de compassion, deux jours de bénévolat rémunérés, flexibilité dans l’organisation du travail et possibilité de congé sabbatique

Venez comme vous êtes

Nous souhaitons rencontrer des personnes de tous horizons. Plus nous sommes inclusifs, meilleur sera notre travail, et nous reconnaissons les talents selon leur mérite et leur potentiel. Si le poste vous enthousiasme mais que vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases, nous serions quand même ravis de vous lire.

Pour en savoir plus, rendez-vous sur notre page carrières et notre LinkedIn. Notre politique de protection des données des candidats est disponible ici.

jobs.description:
About Everfield

Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe's software ecosystem.

Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices, while focusing on what they do best - building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics. Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 9 countries, and growing.

About the Role

This is not a reporting role. It's ownership of the financial engine for a portfolio of growing software businesses.

You'll be accountable end-to-end for the accounting integrity of your portfolio: closing the books accurately, building and leading a team of local finance experts to meet French statutory and regulatory requirements, and making sure every number that reaches Everfield's leadership is right and on time. But the job doesn't stop at accuracy. You'll sit next to Business Unit Leaders as their financial conscience and commercial sparring partner - coaching them on the numbers, challenging their growth plans, and pushing them to allocate resources where they'll actually compound.

Everfield deliberately gives this role more scope than a typical FP&A or controller seat carries at this career stage. You'll run the accounting, build and lead the regional finance team, and shape how each business thinks about growth - the full stack, across multiple companies.

What You'll Do

Own the numbers

• Be accountable for the accuracy and timeliness of monthly reporting (management P&L, KPIs, operating metrics) for each business in your portfolio - not just its preparation.

• Build and manage a team of local financial experts to meet French statutory and regulatory compliance requirements.

• Guide each business's finance and accounting team through migration onto Everfield's NetSuite instance.

• Own the accuracy and timeliness of the underlying accounting work behind every number you report.

• Build and defend annual budgets and rolling forecasts, incorporating strategic initiatives and long-term expectations.

• Prepare Quarterly Update Review (QUR) packs for Everfield's CEO, CFO, and COO.

Drive the growth agenda

• Coach Business Unit Leaders on financial acumen - make sure they understand and consistently apply the Everfield ratios, not just report against them.

• Challenge and support Business Unit Leaders in applying Everfield's prescribed revenue system to their business.

• Help each business spot operating efficiencies, report headcount accurately, and manage overhead with intent.

• Partner with Business Unit Leaders on charting expense management and aligning resources toward growth, not just cost control.

• Play an active role in integration of newly acquired businesses - systems, data, and reporting design, alongside the Integration Director and Head of BI.

• Partner with your Strategic Business Partner (SBP) counterpart on the day-to-day relationship with each business in your region.

Who We're Looking For

• An ambitious problem-solver who wants this role to be a stepping stone – experience on the path towards a CFO or Controller of a larger group of companies, or of a larger standalone business.

• Strong technical grounding in accounting practices and controls - you can run a clean close and hold a third-party provider to a standard, not just review their output.

• Commercial instinct to match: you can sit across from a Business Unit Leader and challenge their growth plan, not just report on whether they hit it.

• A completed university education plus a professional finance qualification (CA/ACA/CIMA or equivalent).

• 5+ years in Business Controlling, FP&A, or Finance Business Partnering.

• Ability to lead and build a team of regional finance specialists.

• Comfort operating in a decentralised, multi-entity, PE-backed environment - you'll manage stakeholders across businesses at very different stages of maturity.

• Fluent in English and French; effective communicator at every level of an organisation, from bookkeeper to CEO.

• Ideally, a background in fast-growing technology or SaaS companies.

• Willingness to travel occasionally.

What We Offer

• Attractive salary package with performance-based bonus.

• Remote flexibility.

• A collaborative team culture based on respect, ownership, and trust.

• Access to international experts within the Everfield ecosystem - accelerate your personal and professional growth.

Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does.

The product fills a real gap. Brands pay influencers to post but then can’t see what happens next. We’re building the first view that shows it: who asked for the link, who opened the DM, who clicked, for every campaign, creator and post.

You’ll work with Product as a partner and stay close to brands and creators, so feedback reaches you fast and helps you shape Manychat for Brands.

Sound like you? Let’s talk!

YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES 👋

We keep Manychat running smoothly under high load every single day and make sure it's ready to scale even further. We do it by combining strong engineering foundations with AI tools that let us move faster without cutting corners. And we're the ones who shape and own what gets built. AI accelerates. Humans own the thinking.

  • Set the architecture and technical priorities for Brands together with the Engineering Manager and the team: service boundaries, data models, authentication, access control, and integration with the core Manychat platform.

  • Lead big system-level changes when the path isn't clear yet. Explore options, split the work into measurable milestones, and plan data migrations, gradual rollouts, and rollbacks.

  • Define reliability and performance requirements for key Brands workflows. Set metrics and observability, and check the impact of your changes on production data.

  • Find the root causes of slowdowns and repeated incidents across service boundaries, using metrics, logs, and distributed tracing.

  • Work with Security, Infrastructure, and Platform teams on solutions. Decide what to fix in the application and what needs other teams, and explain the trade-offs clearly.

  • Work with Product on the approach and scope of solutions, and suggest simpler options when you see them.

  • Make technical decisions easy to follow: document key choices and the reasons behind them, do thorough design and code reviews, and share your knowledge in complex areas.

  • A strong product mindset. You work closely with Product Managers, challenge assumptions, and explain technical trade-offs in terms of user experience, timelines, and product capabilities.

  • Experience owning the architecture and production operations of a product or a large technical area, not only delivering separate features.

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Marketing Ops is one of Alan's highest-leverage functions.

It sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, data, and technology — turning systems into growth engines and ensuring every touchpoint with prospects and members is timely, relevant, and scalable.

Alan is growing fast across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. But today we're leaving value on the table. On the prospect side, we drive more traffic but can't convert it properly: no scoring, no intelligent routing, no nurturing that adapts to buying intent. On the member side, messaging is one of our primary touchpoints for engagement, retention, and trust — yet nobody operates it strategically. Personalization stays shallow, communication pressure goes unmonitored, and shipping a message often means filing an engineering ticket.

We need Marketing Ops leaders who can architect scalable systems, operate them strategically, and progressively embed AI into workflows — to raise quality, reduce manual execution, and unlock growth without scaling headcount linearly.

⭐️ The Marketing Ops job ⭐️

We are hiring two Marketing Operations Managers, each embedded in a different crew:

  • Growth Infrastructure — focused on prospect acquisition: building a unified lead engine that captures, scores, routes, and nurtures across all channels

  • Product Platform — focused on member lifecycle messaging: operating Alan's messaging stack as a scalable service across 1.7M+ profiles

Both roles share the same DNA: strong marketing ops fundamentals, data fluency, a product mindset, and the ability to be both hands-on and strategic. Crew placement will be determined based on the candidate's experience, interests, and fit during the hiring process.

Why is this role interesting?

  • Speed: marketing, product, and sales teams ship campaigns and messages confidently — Marketing Ops turns bottlenecks into force multipliers across every crew

  • Trust: clean data, governed attributes, proper segmentation, and enforced rules mean the right person gets the right message at the right time

  • Scale: as we grow to millions of members across multiple countries, we need operators who keep our platforms clean and the user experience protected — without scaling headcount linearly

  • AI at the frontier: this isn't a maintenance role — you'll identify high-priority use cases for AI agents, train and refine them to a senior marketer's quality bar, and drive real adoption

What will you do with us?

You'll be a partnership with marketers — not a service desk. You'll partner closely with engineers, data, designers, and cross-functional stakeholders (PMMs, sales, growth, product) within a PM-Tech duo crew model.

Regardless of crew, you will own a core set of capabilities:

  • Marketing Automation & CRM: own and optimize our marketing stack (Customer.io, CRM integrations); build automations that enable marketers to launch campaigns independently, at scale, across all geos

  • Data Model & Governance: maintain CRM data quality, attribute/event design, and database hygiene as a sustained practice

  • Segmentation & Lifecycle Design: design and maintain lifecycle stages, segmentation logic, routing rules, and re-engagement flows across multiple audiences and geos

  • Nurturing Infrastructure: own the nurturing stack and campaign processes; make launches autonomous and compliant

  • AI-First Operations: identify, build, and refine AI agents for email copywriting, lead scoring, next-best-action recommendations, and content generation — making marketers AI-powered, not replacing them

  • Performance Monitoring: track the full funnel from first touchpoint to conversion; identify leakage and prioritize from data

  • Documentation & Enablement: create playbooks, train teams on tools and processes, reduce the marginal cost of new campaigns

Then, depending on your crew:

Growth Infrastructure — you'll build a unified lead engine (no more tool-by-tool silos), design lead scoring and routing models, crack multi-channel activation (email, WhatsApp, Voice AI), build AI agents that pre-qualify and enrich leads, and maintain a live feedback loop with BDRs, AEs, and Inbound Sales.

Product Platform — you'll operate Customer.io and back-end triggered emails as one governed system, monitor communication pressure and enforce channel rules, define and enforce recipient lifecycle paths, drive 100% Design Studio adoption, and co-own outbound messaging strategy with PMMs and product teams.

By your first year, we'll know it worked when:

  • At least one AI agent is in production on a key use case (email nurturing, lead categorization, content generation), with a second scoped or live, and adoption is real

  • Any marketer or product Alaner can launch a campaign or ship a message without bottlenecking through ops or engineering

  • CRM data model, attributes, and segments are properly owned, documented, and clean — the data we see is data we can act on

  • Every contact has a documented path through our messaging — segmentation is sharp, messaging is relevant, and pressure is monitored

  • Marketing's contribution to acquisition and engagement is visible and quantifiable, from first touch to conversion


⭐️ Is it you we are looking for? ⭐️


You'll be a great fit for this opportunity if you:

  • Have 5+ years in Marketing operations, growth ops, CRM ops, lifecycle marketing, or lead generation in a tech environment (B2B, B2C, or B2B2C)

  • Have hands-on experience managing marketing automation platforms at scale (Customer.io, Braze, Iterable, HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot, Salesforce, or equivalent)

  • Have a strong understanding of CRM data models — attribute/event design and data hygiene as a sustained practice

  • Can frame and implement processes for lead scoring, nurturing, segmentation, and personalization

  • Have a product knack: you can define what's not working, identify what to build next, and see problems as opportunities to bring more value

  • Bring data fluency and analytical rigor: you read platform and campaign data, surface anomalies, and draw business insights

  • Can be both hands-on and think strategically — you drive the big picture while staying close to execution

  • Have strong stakeholder management skills — you'll partner daily with engineering, product, sales, and marketing teams

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level range.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🧩 Context of the role

You will be part of the Business Strategy & Operations (BSO) team, whose goal is to

  • Define an ambitious strategy to achieve our business objectives and translate this into an actionable plan

  • Monitor and explain our performance towards our business objectives

  • Enable our Sales and Account Management teams to achieve these business objectives and become the most effective commercial teams in the tech industry (i.e., Sales and AM effectiveness, tools, analytics and training)

Across all these areas we work very closely with the Senior Leadership, the Sales, Account Management and Go-to-Market teams. The scope is Global (France, Belgium, Spain and Canada for the time being).

🎯 Your mission

You will be owning medium to large scale/complexity projects (depending on your skills and experience) on the Business Planning and Strategy area. These would include:

  • Business Strategy

    • Work closely with senior business leaders (Business leads, Insurance Lead, Marketing lead, CFO, CEO, etc.) to define Alan’s business plan

    • Frame business and resource allocation decisions (e.g. where to accelerate/slow down in terms of segments or products, where to deploy sales and marketing resources, how to optimize for short vs. long term, what are is the impact on metrics such as payback, LTV, CAC)

    • Propose adjustments to the plan on a quarterly basis and support Board preparation

  • Sales & Account Manager Planning

    • Translate the plan into actionable sales & Account Management objectives, ensuring their quality, scalability and accuracy

    • Build & improve the infrastructure to track these targets (dashboard, models) hand in hand with the data team

  • Performance monitoring & Steering

    • Lead or support strategic explorations (e.g. new segment, new distribution models) to frame strategic decisions

    • Monitor closely results and execution to gather learnings and adjust where necessary, sharing key learnings with the community and the company on a monthly basis

    • Work on transversal topics that allow us to gain insights & better steer the team performance (competition analysis, implementation & monitoring of pricing strategies, ...)

🧐 Skills we are looking for

We look above all for exceptional people motivated and committed in building one of the most effective Strategy and Planning team.

At least 3 years of experience within either:

  • Business strategy, sales strategy & operations, revenue operations or business finance/ strategic finance departments in a B2B company (preferably)

  • Management consulting, investment banking or private equity

Nice to have

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager based in Switzerland.

As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will take full ownership of product marketing strategy in a fast-growing, international AdTech environment. You will shape how innovative advertising technology products are positioned, communicated, and brought to market. Working closely with product, sales, customer success, and other cross-functional teams, you will translate complex technical capabilities into compelling value propositions. You will play a key role in developing go-to-market strategies, enabling commercial teams, and strengthening customer engagement. By combining market intelligence, customer insights, and data-driven storytelling, you will help drive business growth and product adoption. This is an opportunity to join a collaborative, remote-first team and contribute to the evolution of programmatic advertising across mobile and connected TV.


Accountabilities

You will lead product marketing initiatives from strategy development to execution, ensuring consistent positioning and effective communication across customer-facing teams.

  • Develop and execute product marketing strategies to promote products and solutions to existing and prospective B2B customers.

  • Create compelling marketing content and bold narratives that clearly communicate product value, differentiation, and competitive advantages.

  • Collaborate closely with product teams to ensure marketing messaging accurately reflects product features, capabilities, and developments.

  • Lead go-to-market initiatives for new product launches and equip sales and customer success teams with effective messaging and enablement materials.

  • Engage regularly with customers and internal stakeholders to collect feedback, understand market needs, and identify emerging industry trends.

  • Partner with sales and customer success teams to align marketing execution with business objectives and customer insights.

  • Monitor campaign and product marketing performance against key performance indicators, using data to identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Leverage MarTech platforms and AI-powered tools to streamline content creation, improve reporting, optimize segmentation, and deliver personalized marketing experiences.

  • Anticipate market developments and emerging advertising trends, translating them into relevant product positioning and forward-looking marketing narratives.

    • Requirements:

    You are a proactive and strategic marketing professional with strong expertise in B2B advertising technology, excellent communication skills, and the ability to influence teams across a dynamic international organization.

    • At least 5 years of experience in B2B AdTech, ideally within a startup or scaleup environment, with a proven track record in product marketing.

    • Strong understanding of the programmatic advertising ecosystem, particularly mobile advertising trends, challenges, and opportunities.

    • Solid knowledge of AI tools and demonstrated ability to integrate them into everyday marketing workflows.

    • Experience with marketing platforms and tools such as HubSpot and WordPress is a plus.

    • Excellent writing and editing skills, with the ability to develop engaging stories and compelling messaging for B2B audiences.

    • Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate complex data and insights into differentiated marketing narratives.

    • Excellent command of English, both written and spoken.

    • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and adapt quickly to changing priorities.

    • Outstanding organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail.

    • Genuine passion for mobile marketing and app advertising, with a strong interest in emerging technologies and industry developments.

    • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic, remote-first, and international environment.

    • Proven ability to collaborate with and influence cross-functional teams without formal authority, particularly across sales, customer success, and product management.

      • Benefits:

      • Exceptional opportunities for career growth and professional development.

      • The opportunity to work alongside experienced industry experts and entrepreneurs shaping the future of AdTech.

      • Direct, day-to-day collaboration with the leadership team.

      • A fun, ambitious, and multinational team distributed across Europe, India, Argentina, and soon the United States.

      • Flexible work-from-home arrangements.

      • A $500 home-office setup budget.

      • A $1,000 annual learning and development budget.

Build & Lead a High-Performing FDE Team

  • Hire, onboard, and coach Forward Deployed Engineers across your region, partnering closely with Deployment Strategists to deliver high-impact customer engagements.

  • Set and maintain a high technical quality bar for production workflows, custom nodes, integration architectures, and customer-facing delivery.

  • Manage regional team capacity, workload, and staffing while staying hands-on with customer engagements and supporting your team's technical development.

Own Regional Delivery & Customer Outcomes

  • Lead regional engagement intake and prioritization with Customer Success, Sales, and Partnerships, focusing resources on high-value accounts, strategic adoption opportunities, and at-risk renewals.

  • Qualify and scope customer engagements, selecting the right mix of internal FDEs and delivery partners while ensuring clear success criteria, technical ownership, and timelines.

  • Drive measurable customer outcomes through production-ready workflows, increased adoption, and seamless handovers to Customer Success Managers, while reporting regional results and expansion signals to leadership.

Enable Customers & Scale Technical Excellence

  • Champion a customer-first delivery approach where customers build alongside FDEs, develop technical confidence, and become capable of maintaining and scaling their own automations.

  • Create and continuously improve reusable technical assets, including workflow templates, reference architectures, workshop materials, and hackathon playbooks.

  • Capture learnings from customer engagements and turn them into scalable best practices that improve delivery quality and consistency across the global FDE team.

Drive Partner Quality & Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with regional partner managers and the Partner Delivery Manager to ensure partner-led engagements meet n8n's technical and delivery standards.

  • Support partner technical readiness, certification, and quality reviews to build a reliable regional ecosystem of delivery resources.

  • Work closely with Product and Engineering to translate customer feedback, integration gaps, feature requests, and custom node needs into actionable priorities, balancing reusable product improvements with customer-specific solutions.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🛠️ Technical Customer-Facing Experience: You have 6+ years of experience in forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, professional services, or technical consulting within a software company.

  • 🌟 Technical Leadership: You have 2+ years of experience leading and coaching technical teams, with a track record of developing talent and raising the bar for customer-facing technical delivery.

  • ⚡ Automation & Integration Expertise: You have hands-on experience with workflow automation, integration platforms, or low-code tools and can confidently design and troubleshoot complex automation solutions.

  • 🏗️ Enterprise Technical Delivery: You're experienced in building production-ready workflows and integrations, with a strong understanding of APIs, authentication, data handling, security, and enterprise architecture considerations.

  • 🤝 Cross-functional Collaboration: You're comfortable working across Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and Partnerships to align priorities, manage expectations, and make thoughtful trade-offs.

  • 🎯 Customer Outcome Mindset: You know how to balance technical excellence with business impact, identify high-value use cases, and empower customers to become self-sufficient rather than dependent on ongoing services.

  • 🚀 Player-Coach Mentality: You enjoy staying close to the technology and customer challenges while building a high-performing team, creating repeatable processes, and scaling delivery in a fast-moving environment.

  • 🌍 Regional Availability: You're based in the relevant region (EMEA or North America) and comfortable traveling to customer sites when needed.

Nice-to-haves

  • 💻 n8n Expertise: You're familiar with n8n or similar workflow automation and low-code platforms, ideally with experience building complex production workflows.

  • 🤝 Partner Ecosystems: You have experience working with systems integrators, technical consulting partners, or external delivery teams to deliver enterprise customer engagements.

  • 🌱 0-to-1 Team Building: You've helped establish or scale a regional technical delivery team, including hiring, defining processes, and building a strong team culture from the ground up.

Why join us?

At n8n, you'll have the opportunity to build and shape a regional Forward Deployed Engineering team at a pivotal moment in our enterprise growth journey. You won't just lead engineers — you'll help define how we deliver technical excellence, accelerate customer adoption, and turn ambitious automation ideas into real business outcomes.

You'll combine hands-on technical work with people leadership, working closely with Customer Success, Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering to influence how we scale customer delivery across your region. Your work will directly contribute to getting more workflows into production, helping customers become independent builders, and creating scalable technical practices that benefit our global FDE organization.

You'll join one of Europe's fastest-growing startups and a supportive, remote-first team that values autonomy, experimentation, collaboration, and continuous learning.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

As Senior Simulation Engineer – Autonomous Driving, Land Domain, you will play a key role in shaping the simulation capabilities that enable us to develop, test, and validate the next generation of autonomous ground systems at scale. You will design and evolve realistic, reliable, and reproducible virtual environments in which our autonomy software can be developed and challenged long before a physical vehicle enters the field.

You will take strong technical ownership of simulation systems, architecture, and engineering decisions, helping to define how simulation is integrated into our autonomy development and verification workflows. You will tackle complex technical challenges hands-on, challenge existing approaches, identify limitations, and continuously improve the quality, scalability, and effectiveness of our simulation environment.

As a senior engineer, you will also act as a technical sparring partner for other engineers. You will share your expertise, review technical approaches, mentor less experienced colleagues, and contribute to engineering standards and best practices, while enabling teams to retain ownership of their respective systems and decisions.

Working closely with engineers across autonomy, perception, localization, planning and control, platform software, verification, and vehicle integration, you will translate complex simulation needs into robust technical solutions. You will help align interfaces and requirements across teams and ensure that our simulation capabilities address real engineering challenges and become an integral part of autonomy development, continuous testing, and system-level verification.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Take technical ownership of simulation capabilities, contributing to the architecture, technical roadmap, and quality of the simulation systems used for autonomy development, testing, and verification.

  • Design and develop scalable simulation solutions, building realistic, reliable, and reproducible environments that enable autonomy software to be tested across complex scenarios before deployment on physical vehicles.

  • Drive strong engineering decisions, leading technical discussions, challenging assumptions, evaluating trade-offs, and helping teams make pragmatic and sustainable architectural choices.

  • Translate autonomy and verification needs into technical solutions, working closely with stakeholders to turn complex requirements into clear simulation concepts, priorities, and implementation plans.

  • Contribute hands-on to complex engineering challenges, investigating technical limitations, improving simulation fidelity and performance, and solving problems that require deep technical expertise.

  • Drive collaboration across the Land Domain, working closely with autonomy, perception, localization, planning and control, verification, platform software, and vehicle integration teams to identify where simulation provides the greatest engineering value.

  • Keep simulation closely connected to the real system, using field data, vehicle testing, real-world failures, and operational feedback to continuously improve simulation fidelity, coverage, and relevance.

  • Raise the technical standard across the team, sharing knowledge, reviewing technical approaches, mentoring other engineers, and contributing to engineering standards, development practices, and continuous improvement.

  • Identify technical risks and dependencies early, helping teams address scalability, maintainability, integration, and verification challenges before they become blockers.

  • Act as a senior technical interface for simulation, communicating technical challenges, architectural decisions, dependencies, and opportunities clearly across engineering teams and stakeholders.



What you bring to the team:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in simulation, robotics, autonomous driving, physical systems, vehicle dynamics, software engineering, or closely related engineering domains.

  • Strong technical expertise in simulation and autonomous systems, with experience designing, building, and evolving complex simulation environments used for development, testing, and verification.

  • A strong software engineering background, ideally including modern C++ and Python, with hands-on experience building or extending simulation infrastructure using technologies such as CARLA, NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Unreal Engine, Gazebo, or comparable simulation environments.

  • Solid understanding of physical simulation and autonomous systems, including areas such as vehicle dynamics, sensor simulation, Software-in-the-Loop (SiL), scenario-based testing, and the trade-offs between simulation fidelity, performance, determinism, and scalability.

  • Experience taking technical ownership of complex systems, contributing to architecture and technical roadmaps while driving decisions around scalability, maintainability, reliability, and system quality.

  • Proven ability to solve complex engineering problems hands-on, including debugging system-level issues, evaluating technical trade-offs, challenging existing approaches, and developing pragmatic solutions.

  • Experience working across engineering disciplines, collaborating effectively with autonomy, perception, localization, planning and control, verification, platform software, and vehicle integration teams.

  • Experience connecting simulation with real-world systems, using vehicle testing, field data, operational feedback, and real-world failures to improve simulation fidelity, coverage, and relevance.

  • Ability to provide technical guidance and mentorship, supporting other engineers through design discussions, code and architecture reviews, knowledge sharing, and engineering best practices without requiring formal people-management responsibility.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics, influence engineering decisions, align stakeholders, and drive technical topics across organizational boundaries.

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you dont meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.


Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

jobs.title: Senior Privacy Counsel (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Deep Blue Recruitment is working with an international technology company looking to appoint an experienced Senior Privacy Counsel to join its legal team.

Operating in the enterprise technology sector, the business develops software and digital solutions for customers across a range of industries. With continued investment in emerging technologies, including AI, data protection is becoming an increasingly important consideration in how the business develops its products, manages risk and works with customers.

We're looking for a commercially minded privacy lawyer who enjoys working closely with the business, understanding how technology works and finding practical solutions to complex legal questions.

This is a broad, hands-on role combining privacy advisory work, commercial support and the continued development of internal data protection processes.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Advise colleagues across the business on a broad range of privacy and data protection matters, providing clear, commercially focused legal guidance.

  • Work closely with product, technology and commercial teams on the development of new services, ensuring privacy considerations are addressed early in the process.

  • Support the negotiation of commercial agreements, particularly around data processing, international transfers, customer relationships and third-party arrangements.

  • Advise on GDPR and other applicable international data protection regulations, helping the business understand and manage its obligations across different markets.

  • Provide legal guidance on emerging technologies, including AI, and the implications of new products and data processing activities from a privacy perspective.

  • Review and improve existing privacy policies, internal procedures and governance frameworks to ensure they remain practical and fit for purpose.

  • Work alongside information security and IT teams on data governance, risk assessments and privacy-related incidents.

  • Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency of privacy operations, including through automation and better internal processes.

  • Monitor regulatory developments affecting technology businesses, particularly around data protection, AI and digital services.

  • Provide training and guidance to colleagues across the organisation, helping non-legal teams understand their responsibilities when handling personal data.

What They're Looking For

  • A qualified lawyer with approximately 4-10 years experience specialising in data protection, privacy or technology law, gained in private practice, in-house or a combination of both.

  • Strong knowledge of GDPR and European data protection law, including regulatory guidance and its practical application within commercial organisations.

  • Experience advising technology businesses, ideally with exposure to software, AI, digital products or other data-intensive environments.

  • A good understanding of artificial intelligence technologies and the legal and regulatory challenges associated with their development and use.

  • Experience advising on commercial agreements involving personal data, international transfers and complex data processing arrangements.

  • Comfortable working directly with product, engineering and technical stakeholders, with the ability to understand complex issues and provide clear, practical legal advice.

  • A commercial approach to risk management, recognising that the role of legal is to help the business find workable solutions rather than simply identify problems.

  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities independently.

  • Experience working within an international business or advising on privacy matters across multiple jurisdictions would be beneficial.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

This is an opportunity to join an international technology business where privacy plays an important role in how the company operates, develops its products and works with customers.

You'll have a broad remit, working closely with different teams across the organisation on a range of commercial, operational and regulatory matters, including some of the challenges emerging technologies bring to data protection.

If you're a privacy lawyer who enjoys working closely with the business, has an interest in technology and takes a practical approach to solving legal challenges, we'd be interested in hearing from you.

jobs.title: EMEA Platform Solution Architect
Workplace Experience - Healthcare Sites Development Manager
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Healthcare Sites Development Manager

People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work, such as:

🎯 What drives us — We're obsessed with helping our members live healthier

  • Mission is the Boss: long-term thinking, seeking our mission success above all else.

  • Member & customer-led: obsessively focused on solving members & customers problems and creating the most delightful experiences.

🏆 How we build excellence — We hire the best people and give them platform to succeed

  • Champions of excellence: extremely high standards and talent density.

  • Distributed ownership: accountable enlightened despots, everyone owns their decisions and results.

  • Radically transparent: all information is accessible and written-first, so everyone can make the best decisions asynchronously.

🤝 How we grow together — We help each other improve through honest feedback and bold thinking

  • Optimistic alchemy: optimists who collaborate with genuine care and support teammates.

  • Empathetic challengers: direct, caring feedback combined with praises to help each other grow professionally.

  • Bold & creative contrarians: think differently to achieve greatness, try new approaches.

⚡ How we move fast — We fight complexity and focus on what matters most

  • Disciplined in execution: taking decisive actions with focus that compounds success over time.

  • Fight for simplicity: only high impact processes, smart frugality.

💡 The Missions

Prévenir is a new Occupational Health and Prevention Service (SPSTI) in Île-de-France, built to rethink occupational health with Alan's technology, for the benefit of employees and of healthcare professionals (HPs).

Its first medical centre opened at Valmy (Paris 10th) in April 2026, and 4 sites are already running.

Prévenir is about to scale fast: the ambition is to open several new small centres around Paris in 2027 (Seine-et-Marne, Val-d'Oise), first inside ready-to-operate sites, then in premises of its own (rented or bought), including a flagship centre in Paris. The exact plan is still being shaped, and you will help shape it.

We are looking for someone senior and visionary enough to carry the vision and strategy of Prévenir's sites from day one, while being happy (and excited) to be hands-on as much as needed, with a start-up mindset. Health, member experience and innovation are at the heart of the role.

You would join Alan as a full-time Alaner in the Workplace team: you work for Alan, not only for Prévenir. At first, most of your time goes to Prévenir: opening new sites, making them compliant and ready for patients with a real Prevenir's spirit, running the centres day to day with the center managers, and building the vendors, budgets and playbook that will let it grow from 4 to many more sites.

Prévenir is a separate entity from Alan: it signs its own leases and contracts, and you prepare, negotiate and advise on its behalf.

You will work alongside the Facility Manager in charge of Alan's offices at Valmy, and turn what you learn into playbooks, checklists and templates (openings, fit-out, vendors, compliance) that serve Prévenir's centres as much as Alan's own offices.

The position is based in Paris, with regular field visits across Île-de-France (Paris, Seine-et-Marne, Hauts-de-Seine, Val-d'Oise), and requires an onsite or field presence at least 4 days per week.

👀 More specificities on the profile we're looking for (level range targeted on our level grid: C1-D)

Detailed missions

Set the vision

  • Define and carry the vision and strategy for Prévenir's sites from day one: site model, technical and experience standards, and a 2–3 year real-estate roadmap, alongship Prévenir's and Alan's leadership and kept up to date as the plan evolves

  • Bring innovation: test new centre formats (shared, modular or temporary sites), and have a smart use of AI to make each opening faster, cheaper and better for HPs and patients

Open and build new sites

  • Find and technically qualify new sites: define search criteria with the Occupational Health team, visit candidate sites, and give a clear go / no-go recommendation with an estimated cost

  • Open small centres inside ready-to-operate sites: check that the host site works for medical use, agree the terms with the host operator (services, charges, service levels, who does what), do the light set-up and prepare the opening

  • Prepare and negotiate leases with Legal and Finance, and be the single operational point of contact for landlords, architects and vendors

  • When relevant, lead fit-out works end to end: brief and manage architects, project managers and contractors, plan backwards from the opening date, secure administrative and safety authorisations, manage acceptance and close snags

  • Contribute to the rent vs buy thinking by providing technical due diligence on any potential acquisition (condition of the building, works to expect, regulatory constraints, running costs)

Make every centre medical-ready, unique, safe and healthy

  • Make every site ready for patients: consultation rooms, patient flows, confidentiality (acoustics), hygiene and cleaning, medical waste, hand-washing points, IT / network and badge access set up with the IT team

  • Own the safety and security of every centre, for patients, HPs and visitors: access control, intrusion alarms and video surveillance where relevant (in line with GDPR), fire safety, evacuation procedures and drills, first-aid kits and defibrillators where required, and clear procedures for incidents and for HPs working alone

  • Put prevention at the heart of the run: identify the main risk areas of each centre (fire safety, HVAC and air quality, water, electrical, access control), build and run the preventive maintenance calendar, plan the mandatory periodic checks and keep each site's safety register up to date

Run the centres day to day

  • Run the day-to-day for existing and new centres with the center managers (ASSTs): sort and diagnose requests, fix what can be fixed, send the rest to the right contractor, and follow each intervention until it is done and checked

  • Own the logistical run of the centres in partnership with the center managers: supplies, snacks, mail, printing, small furniture and IT equipment, access and badges, cleaning. Agree a clear split of who does what and give them simple routines, checklists and documentation so they become autonomous

  • Create and keep alive the Prévenir spirit in every centre, as the Workplace team does for Alan its own offices: a welcoming, consistent and on-brand place for HPs, ASSTs and patients, using their feedback to keep improving it

Manage vendors, budgets and playbooks

  • Build a standard vendor panel (maintenance, fire safety, cleaning, medical waste, access control, furniture) with SLAs, penalties and exit terms. Run tenders and invoice checks, and reuse contracts across sites

  • Own the budget with Finance and the Occupational Health team: capex (fit-out, equipment, furniture) and opex (rent, charges, maintenance) per site, monthly follow-up, and realistic figures to feed the medical centres business model

  • Track, improve and document: run a simple dashboard (open requests, intervention times, openings progress, budget), keep the equipment inventory and maintenance log, automate repetitive follow-ups with AI and tools, and write the opening playbook and technical checklist reused for each new site

Be a full member of the Workplace team

  • Take part in the team's rituals and priorities, work with Alan's Workplace scope and join the on-call rotation (daily Office Management tasks)

Key outcomes by 1 year

  • A vision and a 2–3 year real-estate roadmap for Prévenir's sites are shared and approved by Prévenir's leadership and Alan within the first 3 months, and kept up to date

  • Existing centres are under control: contracts, leases, mandatory checks, equipment, open requests and risks are mapped and documented, with no missed regulatory check or expired contract

  • Preventive maintenance plans and safety registers are live on every centre, with at least 3 prevention areas identified, each with an action plan and KPIs

  • One single channel logs and tracks requests from the centres, each with an owner and a deadline; resolution time is measured and decreasing; a dashboard tracks requests, openings and budget; at least 3 recurring tasks are automated

  • The new centres planned for 2027 open on time, with safety, accessibility and authorisations validated before the first patient and a budget under control

  • A replicable opening playbook, a building technical checklist, a standard vendor panel and standard contract templates are in place and reused across sites

  • Every centre feels like Prévenir, is safe and secure (access control, alarms and emergency procedures in place and tested, drills done on time), and is healthy.

  • At least one innovation (new centre format, building tech or AI use case) has been tested in a centre, with clear results on cost, speed or HP and patient experience

You may be a great fit if you are:

  • A multi-site Facility / Technical Manager (6–10 years of experience) in a network of regulated, public-access sites: clinics, medical or radiology centres, labs, dental or health-centre networks, nurseries, fitness, retail networks

  • A real-estate project manager in charge of network expansion and site openings, with a real sensitivity to the run

  • A head of technical services of a clinic or private hospital who wants to move to a growth environment

  • A works / fit-out project manager (chef de projet travaux, maîtrise d'ouvrage) with strong ERP experience and some maintenance and run exposure

  • A site or contract manager at an FM service provider (healthcare accounts) who wants to move in-house, or a Workplace / Facility Manager in a scale-up who has led several office openings or moves

What we're looking for

  • Solid technical understanding of buildings: HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire safety systems, doors and access control, and the ability to challenge a technician or an architect

  • Proven experience of opening or fitting out sites: works follow-up with architects, project managers and contractors, planning, acceptance, snags

  • Knowledge of the French regulatory framework for public-access buildings (ERP classification, safety commission, works authorisation, accessibility, mandatory periodic checks, safety register)

  • Good knowledge of site safety and security: access control, intrusion alarms, video surveillance (and related GDPR rules), evacuation and emergency procedures, incident management

  • Lease and landlord management: you can read a lease, understand who pays and does what, and negotiate with landlords and agents

  • Proven vendor and contract management (SLAs, penalties, price indexation, tenders, invoice control) and budget ownership (capex / opex per site, total cost of ownership)

  • Project management of several sites in parallel, with strong prioritisation, including urgent incidents

  • Ability to work with senior and varied stakeholders: HPs and doctors, directors, Legal, Finance, IT, landlords, architects

  • Senior enough to set a vision and a strategy, and to carry and defend it with Prévenir's leadership and Alan, with a start-up mindset: frugal, fast, comfortable building from scratch with changing priorities, and happy to be hands-on

  • Exceptional communication in French (fluent) and professional English

  • A member-first mindset: you think about the HP, patient and Alaner experience, not the process

  • Appetite for digital tools, AI and basic automation to reduce repetitive work, and the ability to document in a way the whole team and AI agents can leverage

  • Mobility across Île-de-France (Paris, 77, 92, 95 and more)

  • Visionary and hands-on, autonomous and proactive, at ease with ambiguity while the plan (number of sites, rent vs buy, timing) is still evolving, calm when things don't go as planned, and discreet and respectful of the medical environment

Nice to have

  • Experience of medical, paramedical or health-related sites (centres de santé, clinics, labs), including ERP type U requirements

  • A technical diploma or certification (BTS / DUT in building maintenance or energy, SSIAP) and electrical habilitation

  • Experience of a technical due diligence on a building purchase, or of a sale-and-leaseback / long-lease structure

  • Experience with indoor air quality or energy-efficiency projects

  • Experience using a CMMS / GMAO tool, or building one with no-code tools

  • Extensive experience leveraging AI to build scalable processes or automate recurring tasks

  • Prior experience in a high-growth company or scale-up, ideally in a network-expansion context

 

🙌 Perks & Benefits


At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance. Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% of the contribution covered by Alan for you and your family.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

 

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.


We'll be thrilled to receive your application!


🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.
